# Labelarium: full reference

Unofficial reference for label makers. Key names are in `backticks`; text shown on the device's screen is in “quotes”. Source: https://labelarium.com

## Brother P-touch PT-D220
Home & Office Everyday Label Maker. 649 symbols in 30 categories, 100 frames, 25 templates, 14 fonts, 11 styles, 22 shortcuts, 25 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220

### How-to guides

#### Save tape: margins (Full / Half / Narrow / Chain) (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/margins

1. Press `Label`.
2. Use `◀` / `▶` until “Margin” shows, then `OK`.
3. Pick “Full” (25 mm each side), “Half” (12 mm), “Narrow” (4 mm) or “Chain Print”, then `OK`.

Note: The ~25 mm lead-in before the first label cannot be eliminated (it is the distance from print head to cutter). With Half / Narrow the device prints two dots (:). Cut there with scissors so the margins are even.
Note: For several labels in a row use Chain Print (below). Later labels lose the lead-in entirely.
Note: Fix for "too much blank tape on both sides of the text".

#### Chain Print: many labels, minimal waste (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/chain

1. `Label` → “Margin” → `OK` → “Chain Print” → `OK`.
2. Type the first label and press `Print`. When “Copies:” shows, set the number and press `OK`.
3. When "Feed OK?" appears press `Esc` to keep going.
4. Clear the text (keep the format), type the next label, press `Print`.
5. After the last label press `OK` at "Feed OK?" so the tape feeds, then push the cutter lever.

Note: Feed before cutting, otherwise the last label may be cut through.
Note: When a specific label is done printing you can also cut manually with the lever. Only after "Please Cut".

#### Two-line labels (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/two-lines

1. Type line 1.
2. Press `Enter` where the second line should start (a ↵ appears on the LCD).
3. Type line 2. Print.

Note: Needs 9 mm or 12 mm tape. On 3.5 / 6 mm you get "2 Line Limit!". The same message appears if you press Enter a third time.

#### Fixed label length (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/length

1. Press `Label`.
2. “Label Length” → `OK`.
3. Use `◀` / `▶` to pick “Auto” or 30–300 mm (1.2"–12"), then `OK`.

Note: A 🔒 appears on the LCD when a length is fixed. Press `Space` in the setting to return to Auto.
Note: "Change Length!" means the text no longer fits: shorten it or return to Auto.
Note: After printing, cut along the printed dots (:) so the length matches.

#### Tabs and tab length (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/tabs

1. Insert a tab with `Tab` (or `Menu` → “Tab” → `OK`). A ▯ shows in the text.
2. Tab length: `Label` → “Tab Length” → `OK` → “Auto” or 0–100 mm → `OK`.

Note: Up to 80 tabs in a label with no text (79 with one letter). `Space` resets tab length to Auto.

#### Upper and lower case (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/caps

1. Press `Caps` to toggle upper case for everything you type (Caps indicator on the LCD).
2. Hold `Shift` while typing one letter for a single capital.

#### Accented characters (é ñ ü …) (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/accents

1. Type the letter.
2. Press `Accent`. Press `Accent` again (or `◀` / `▶`) to cycle the variants.
3. Press `OK`.

Note: See the Accent table under Symbols for every variant. Order depends on the LCD language.

#### Clear text and/or formatting (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/clear

1. `BS` deletes one character (Backspace).
2. `Shift` + `BS` → choose “Text&Format” (everything) or “Text Only” (keep font, frame, margins) → `OK`.
3. Alternative: `Menu` → “Clear” → `OK` → “Text&Format” / “Text Only” → `OK`.

#### Preview a label (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/preview

1. Press `Preview` (the magnifier key).
2. Scroll a long label with `◀` / `▶`.
3. Leave with `Esc`, `OK` or `Enter`.

Note: The preview is generated and may differ slightly from the print. Not available for pattern templates.

#### Feed blank tape (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/feed

1. Press `Shift` + `Preview`. About 25 mm (1") of tape feeds.

#### Print and print copies (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/print-copies

1. Press `Print`. “Copies:” appears.
2. Use `◀` / `▶` or type a digit for 1–9 copies (or just press `OK` for one).
3. Press `OK`.
4. When "Please Cut" appears push the cutter lever at the top right.

Note: Never press the lever while "Please Wait" is displayed. It jams the tape.
Note: To peel: fold the label lengthwise with text inside so the backing splits, then peel each half.

#### Numbering (auto-increment serial labels) (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/numbering

1. Type the text including the number, e.g. “0123”.
2. Move the cursor onto the number to increment with `◀` / `▶`.
3. Press `Shift` + `Print`.
4. “Numbering” → `OK`.
5. Use `◀` / `▶` to set the highest number to print (e.g. 0125 prints 0123, 0124, 0125), then `OK`.

Note: Up to 9 labels per run. "Invalid!" means the cursor is not on a number.

#### Mirror print (for glass and windows) (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/mirror

1. Type the text.
2. Press `Shift` + `Print`.
3. `◀` / `▶` to “Mirror” → `OK`.
4. “Mirror Print?” → `OK`.

Note: Use clear tape so the label reads correctly from the other side of the glass.

#### Save, open and print stored labels (30 slots) (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/files

1. Save: type the label → `File` → `◀` / `▶` to “Save” → `OK` → `◀` / `▶` to a slot number (1–30) → `OK`. Choosing an occupied slot asks "Overwrite OK?".
2. Print a stored label: `File` → “Print” → `OK` → pick the slot → `OK` → “Copies:” → `OK`.
3. Open for editing: `File` → “Open” → `OK` → pick the slot → `OK`.
4. Shortcut into the File menu: `Menu` → `1`.

Note: 80 characters per file, 2400 in total. Files are lost after a reset, a repair, or if power is cut for a long time. Keep good batteries in as memory backup even when using the adapter.
Note: Labels made with templates cannot be saved.

#### Font, size, width, style and alignment (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/font

1. Press `Font`.
2. Use `◀` / `▶` to pick “Font”, “Size”, “Width”, “Style” or “Alignment”, then `OK`.
3. Use `◀` / `▶` to pick the setting, then `OK`.

Note: See the Fonts & styles section for samples of all 14 fonts and 11 styles.
Note: Vertical style prints each character rotated so the label reads top-to-bottom when hung vertically.

#### Add a frame (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/frame

1. Press `Frame`.
2. Type the frame number (0–99) or browse with `◀` / `▶`.
3. Press `OK`.

Note: Frames 84–99 need 12 mm tape. See the Frames section to browse all designs with their numbers.

#### Insert a symbol or pictogram (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/symbol

1. Press `Symbol`.
2. Choose “History”, “Basic” or “Pictograph” with `◀` / `▶`, then `OK`.
3. Choose the category (or press its shortcut letter), then `OK`.
4. Move to the symbol with `◀` / `▶`, then `OK`.

Note: History holds your 7 most recent symbols. Every category page in this app shows the shortcut key and each symbol's position.

#### Use the template library (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/templates

1. Press `Template Library`.
2. “Select Category”: “Text” or “Patterns” → `OK`.
3. Pick a design → `OK`, then follow the prompts (“Input Text 1”, “Input Text 2” or “Set Label Length”).
4. “Print” → `OK`.

Note: 12 mm tape only. See the Templates section for pictures of all 25 designs.

#### Language and units (inch / mm) (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/language-unit

1. Language: `Menu` → `◀` / `▶` to “Language” → `OK` → pick → `OK`. Shortcut: `Menu` → `Space`.
2. Unit: `Menu` → “Unit” → `OK` → “inch” / “mm” → `OK`. Shortcut: `Menu` → `3`.

Note: 22 languages: English, Español, Français, Hrvatski, Italiano, Magyar, Nederlands, Norsk, Polski, Português, Portug. (BR), Română, Slovenski, Slovenský, Suomi, Svenska, Türkçe, Čeština, Dansk, Deutsch.

#### LCD contrast (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/contrast

1. `Menu` → “LCD Contrast” → `OK` → `◀` / `▶` for −2 … +2 → `OK`. Shortcut: `Menu` → `4`.

Note: `Space` returns to the default (0).

#### Factory reset (also fixes a locked-up device) (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/reset

1. Turn the device off.
2. Hold `Shift` and `R`, then press `Power` to turn it on.
3. Release `Power` first, then release `Shift` and `R`.

Note: Everything is erased: text, settings, all 30 stored files, language and unit.

#### Move around long text (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/cursor

1. `◀` / `▶` move one character.
2. `Shift` + `▶` jumps to the end, `Shift` + `◀` to the start.
3. The LCD shows 15 characters at a time; the label can hold 80.

#### Batteries, adapter and auto power off (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/power

1. Use 6 × AAA alkaline (LR03) or fully charged Ni-MH (HR03). Replace all six together, never mix types.
2. Optional adapter AD-24ES / AD-24ESA plugs into the jack at the top. Keep batteries in as memory backup.
3. The device switches off after 5 idle minutes. Text and settings survive 3 minutes without any power; longer and they are lost.

Note: The device cannot charge Ni-MH cells.

#### Change the tape cassette (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/tape

1. Switch off. Press the marked area at the top end to open the cassette cover.
2. Pull the old cassette straight up.
3. Insert the new TZe cassette until it clicks, making sure the tape end runs under the tape guides.
4. Close the cover.

Note: Only Brother TZe tapes with the TZe mark work. Never print with an empty cassette. It damages the print head.
Note: Blank line through the print? Wipe the print head with a dry cotton swab.

#### Replace a blunt cutter (TC-4) (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/howto/cutter

1. Open the cassette cover and remove the tape.
2. Pull the two green sections of the cutter unit out in the direction of the arrows.
3. Push the new TC-4 unit in until it locks.

Note: Never touch the blade with your fingers.

### Error messages

#### “Battery Low! / Battery Empty!” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/battery-low-battery-empty

Meaning: Batteries are weak or nearly flat.
Fix: Replace all six alkaline cells, or fully charge the Ni-MH cells.

#### “Invalid!” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/invalid

Meaning: Numbering with no number under the cursor, an invalid character selected for Numbering, or an invalid Tab / Label Length value (also inside templates).
Fix: Move the cursor onto a digit, or enter a value within range.

#### “No Text!” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/no-text

Meaning: Print, Preview, Feed, Numbering or a template step was requested with no text entered, or you tried to print an empty file slot.
Fix: Type some text first.

#### “2 Line Limit! / 1 Line Limit!” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/2-line-limit-1-line-limit

Meaning: You pressed Enter for a third line, or tried two lines on 3.5 / 6 mm tape.
Fix: Use 9 or 12 mm tape for two lines; keep to two lines max.

#### “No Cassette!” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/no-cassette

Meaning: Print, feed or preview with no tape installed.
Fix: Insert a TZe cassette.

#### “Cutter Pressed” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/cutter-pressed

Meaning: The cutter lever was pushed while printing.
Fix: Wait for "Please Cut" before cutting.

#### “Text Full!” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/text-full

Meaning: 80 characters (50 in templates) already entered.
Fix: Shorten the text.

#### “Change Length” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/change-length

Meaning: The text is longer than the fixed label length.
Fix: Reduce the text or set Label Length back to Auto (`Space` in the setting).

#### “No Frame OK?” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/no-frame-ok

Meaning: Frame set on 3.5 mm tape, or a 12 mm-only frame (84–99) on narrower tape.
Fix: `OK` prints without the frame, `Esc` cancels. Or switch to 12 mm tape.

#### “Feed OK?” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/feed-ok

Meaning: Shown after each label when Chain Print is on.
Fix: `OK` feeds the tape (do this before cutting the last label); `Esc` continues with the next label.

#### “Insert 0.47"” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/insert-0-47

Meaning: Templates need 12 mm tape.
Fix: Install a 12 mm (0.47") cassette.

#### “Use TZe Tape!” (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/use-tze-tape

Meaning: The cassette is not a TZe tape.
Fix: Use a cassette with the TZe mark.

### Problems and fixes

#### Display stays blank after power on (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/display-stays-blank-after-power-on

Check battery orientation, replace weak batteries, or check the adapter is plugged in properly.

#### Too much blank tape on both sides of the text (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/too-much-blank-tape-on-both-sides-of-the-text

Label → Margin → Half or Narrow. Use Chain Print for batches. The first 25 mm lead-in cannot be removed.

#### Nothing prints, or characters are malformed (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/nothing-prints-or-characters-are-malformed

Check the cassette is inserted correctly and not empty, and that the cover is closed. Weak batteries also cause faint or broken print.

#### Settings cleared on their own (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/settings-cleared-on-their-own

Weak batteries, or power was disconnected for more than 3 minutes.

#### Blank horizontal line through the label (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/blank-horizontal-line-through-the-label

Dust on the print head: remove the cassette and gently wipe the head up and down with a dry cotton swab.

#### Device locked up (keys do nothing) (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/device-locked-up-keys-do-nothing

Do the factory reset: off → hold Shift + R → Power → release Power, then Shift and R.

#### Power turns off when printing (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/power-turns-off-when-printing

Weak batteries, wrong adapter, or batteries inserted incorrectly. Use AD-24ES / AD-24ESA.

#### Tape does not feed or gets stuck (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/tape-does-not-feed-or-gets-stuck

Make sure the tape end runs under the guides. Do not touch the cutter lever while printing.

#### Tape jammed inside (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/tape-jammed-inside

Open the cover, remove the cassette, gently pull out the jammed tape and rewind slack into the cassette with a fingertip before re-inserting.

#### Cutter does not cut cleanly (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/cutter-does-not-cut-cleanly

Replace the cutter unit (TC-4).

#### Want to start a fresh label (Brother PT-D220)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d220/trouble/want-to-start-a-fresh-label

Shift + BS → Text&Format → OK.

### Shortcuts

- `Menu` → `1`: File menu
- `Menu` → `2`: Insert a Tab
- `Menu` → `3`: Unit (inch / mm)
- `Menu` → `4`: LCD Contrast (−2 … +2)
- `Menu` → `BS`: Clear (Text & Format, or Text Only)
- `Menu` → `Space`: Language
- `Shift` + `BS`: Clear text and/or format
- `Shift` + `Preview`: Feed about 25 mm (1") of blank tape
- `Shift` + `Print`: Print Options: Numbering or Mirror
- `Shift` + `▶`: Jump cursor to the end of the text
- `Shift` + `◀`: Jump cursor to the start of the text
- `Frame` → number keys → `OK`: Pick a frame directly by its number (0–99)
- `Symbol` → “Basic” or “Pictograph” → `OK` → letter key: Jump straight to a symbol category (see each category for its key)
- `Print` → digit key: Set number of copies (1–9) by typing it
- `Space` (inside any setting): Return that setting to its default (e.g. Label Length → Auto)
- `Esc`: Cancel anything, exit preview or templates
- `Shift` + digit: Type the symbol printed above the digit: ! @ # $ % ' & * ( ) and " on the − key
- `Shift` + `,` / `.` / `;`: Type ? / and :
- letter → `Accent` → `Accent`…: Cycle accented letters (é è ê ë …), `OK` to insert
- `Enter`: New line (2-line label on 9 / 12 mm tape)
- `Esc` / `OK` / `Enter` in preview: Leave the preview
- `Power` off → hold `Shift` + `R` → press `Power`: Factory reset (clears everything; release Power first, then Shift and R)

### Specs

- Tape: Brother TZe laminated tape, 3.5 / 6 / 9 / 12 mm (0.13" / 0.23" / 0.35" / 0.47")
- Print: 180 dpi thermal transfer, up to 20 mm/s, 2 lines max (9 & 12 mm tape)
- Text: Up to 80 characters per label (50 in templates), 15-character one-row LCD
- Fonts: 14 fonts · 3 sizes · 3 widths · 11 styles · 4 alignments
- Decorations: 99 frames (+ underline) · 25 templates · 600+ symbols in 30 categories
- Memory: 30 saved labels (80 chars each, 2400 total). History keeps the last 7 symbols
- Power: 6 × AAA alkaline (LR03) or Ni-MH (HR03), or AC adapter AD-24ES / AD-24ESA (optional)
- Auto power off: After 5 minutes idle. Text & settings survive 3 minutes without power
- Size / weight: 157 × 150 × 68 mm, 490 g without batteries
- Cutter: Manual lever; replacement cutter unit TC-4

## Brother P-touch PT-D210
Easy-to-Use Label Maker. 621 symbols in 27 categories, 99 frames, 27 templates, 14 fonts, 10 styles, 22 shortcuts, 25 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210

#### Font, size, width, style and alignment (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/font

1. Press `Font`.
2. Use `◀` / `▶` to pick “Font”, “Size”, “Width”, “Style” or “Alignment”, then `OK`.
3. Use `◀` / `▶` to pick the setting, then `OK`.

Note: See the Fonts & styles section for samples of all 14 fonts and 10 styles (there is no I+Solid on the D210).
Note: Vertical style prints each character rotated so the label reads top-to-bottom when hung vertically.

#### Add a frame (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/frame

1. Press `Frame`.
2. Type the frame number (01–99) or browse with `◀` / `▶`.
3. Press `OK`.

Note: Sheet 01 is Off; 02 is underline. Highlighted numbers (27, 28, 53, 77, 84, 86, 87, 90, 92–99) need 12 mm tape. See the Frames section to browse all designs with their numbers.

#### Insert a symbol or pictogram (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/symbol

1. Press `Symbol`.
2. Choose “History”, “Basic” or “Pictograph” with `◀` / `▶`, then `OK`.
3. Choose the category (or press its shortcut letter), then `OK`.
4. Move to the symbol with `◀` / `▶`, then `OK`.

Note: History holds your 7 most recent symbols. Every category page in this app shows the shortcut key and each symbol's position.

#### Use the template library (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/templates

1. Press `Template Library`.
2. “Select Category”: “Text” or “Patterns” → `OK`.
3. Pick a design → `OK`, then follow the prompts (“Input Text 1”, “Input Text 2” or “Set Label Length”).
4. “Print” → `OK`.

Note: 12 mm tape only. See the Templates section for pictures of all 27 designs (17 text + 10 pattern).

#### Language and units (inch / mm) (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/language-unit

1. Language: `Menu` → `◀` / `▶` to “Language” → `OK` → pick → `OK`. Shortcut: `Menu` → `Space`.
2. Unit: `Menu` → “Unit” → `OK` → “inch” / “mm” → `OK`. Shortcut: `Menu` → `3`.

Note: 22 languages: English, Español, Français, Hrvatski, Italiano, Magyar, Nederlands, Norsk, Polski, Português, Portug. (BR), Română, Slovenski, Slovenský, Suomi, Svenska, Türkçe, Čeština, Dansk, Deutsch.

#### LCD contrast (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/contrast

1. `Menu` → “LCD Contrast” → `OK` → `◀` / `▶` for −2 … +2 → `OK`. Shortcut: `Menu` → `4`.

Note: `Space` returns to the default (0).

#### Factory reset (also fixes a locked-up device) (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/reset

1. Turn the device off.
2. Hold `Shift` and `R`, then press `Power` to turn it on.
3. Release `Power` first, then release `Shift` and `R`.

Note: Everything is erased: text, settings, all 30 stored files, language and unit.

#### Move around long text (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/cursor

1. `◀` / `▶` move one character.
2. `Shift` + `▶` jumps to the end, `Shift` + `◀` to the start.
3. The LCD shows 15 characters at a time; the label can hold 80.

#### Batteries, adapter and auto power off (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/power

1. Use 6 × AAA alkaline (LR03) or fully charged Ni-MH (HR03). Replace all six together, never mix types.
2. Optional adapter AD-24ES / AD-24ESA (and listed variants) plugs into the jack at the top. Keep batteries in as memory backup.
3. The device switches off after 5 idle minutes. Text and settings survive 3 minutes without any power; longer and they are lost.

Note: The device cannot charge Ni-MH cells.

#### Change the tape cassette (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/tape

1. Switch off. Press the marked area at the top end to open the cassette cover.
2. Pull the old cassette straight up.
3. Insert the new TZe cassette until it clicks, making sure the tape end runs under the tape guides.
4. Close the cover.

Note: Only Brother TZe tapes with the TZe mark work. Never print with an empty cassette. It damages the print head.
Note: Blank line through the print? Wipe the print head with a dry cotton swab.

#### Replace a blunt cutter (TC-4) (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/howto/cutter

1. Open the cassette cover and remove the tape.
2. Pull the two green sections of the cutter unit out in the direction of the arrows.
3. Push the new TC-4 unit in until it locks.

Note: Never touch the blade with your fingers.

### Error messages

#### “Battery Low! / Battery Empty!” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/battery-low-battery-empty

Meaning: Batteries are weak or nearly flat.
Fix: Replace all six alkaline cells, or fully charge the Ni-MH cells.

#### “Invalid!” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/invalid

Meaning: Numbering with no number under the cursor, an invalid character selected for Numbering, or an invalid Tab / Label Length value (also inside templates).
Fix: Move the cursor onto a digit, or enter a value within range.

#### “No Text!” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/no-text

Meaning: Print, Preview, Feed, Numbering or a template step was requested with no text entered, or you tried to print an empty file slot.
Fix: Type some text first.

#### “2 Line Limit! / 1 Line Limit!” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/2-line-limit-1-line-limit

Meaning: You pressed Enter for a third line, or tried two lines on 3.5 / 6 mm tape.
Fix: Use 9 or 12 mm tape for two lines; keep to two lines max.

#### “No Cassette!” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/no-cassette

Meaning: Print, feed or preview with no tape installed.
Fix: Insert a TZe cassette.

#### “Cutter Pressed” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/cutter-pressed

Meaning: The cutter lever was pushed while printing.
Fix: Wait for "Please Cut" before cutting.

#### “Text Full!” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/text-full

Meaning: 80 characters (50 in templates) already entered.
Fix: Shorten the text.

#### “Change Length” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/change-length

Meaning: The text is longer than the fixed label length.
Fix: Reduce the text or set Label Length back to Auto (`Space` in the setting).

#### “No Frame OK?” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/no-frame-ok

Meaning: Frame set on 3.5 mm tape, or a 12 mm-only (highlighted) frame on narrower tape.
Fix: `OK` prints without the frame, `Esc` cancels. Or switch to 12 mm tape.

#### “Feed OK?” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/feed-ok

Meaning: Shown after each label when Chain Print is on.
Fix: `OK` feeds the tape (do this before cutting the last label); `Esc` continues with the next label.

#### “Insert 0.47"” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/insert-0-47

Meaning: Templates need 12 mm tape.
Fix: Install a 12 mm (0.47") cassette.

#### “Use TZe Tape!” (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/use-tze-tape

Meaning: The cassette is not a TZe tape.
Fix: Use a cassette with the TZe mark.

### Problems and fixes

#### Display stays blank after power on (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/display-stays-blank-after-power-on

Check battery orientation, replace weak batteries, or check the adapter is plugged in properly.

#### Too much blank tape on both sides of the text (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/too-much-blank-tape-on-both-sides-of-the-text

Label → Margin → Half or Narrow. Use Chain Print for batches. The first 25 mm lead-in cannot be removed.

#### Nothing prints, or characters are malformed (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/nothing-prints-or-characters-are-malformed

Check the cassette is inserted correctly and not empty, and that the cover is closed. Weak batteries also cause faint or broken print.

#### Settings cleared on their own (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/settings-cleared-on-their-own

Weak batteries, or power was disconnected for more than 3 minutes.

#### Blank horizontal line through the label (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/blank-horizontal-line-through-the-label

Dust on the print head: remove the cassette and gently wipe the head up and down with a dry cotton swab.

#### Device locked up (keys do nothing) (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/device-locked-up-keys-do-nothing

Do the factory reset: off → hold Shift + R → Power → release Power, then Shift and R.

#### Power turns off when printing (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/power-turns-off-when-printing

Weak batteries, wrong adapter, or batteries inserted incorrectly. Use AD-24ES / AD-24ESA (or a listed variant).

#### Tape does not feed or gets stuck (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/tape-does-not-feed-or-gets-stuck

Make sure the tape end runs under the guides. Do not touch the cutter lever while printing.

#### Tape jammed inside (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/tape-jammed-inside

Open the cover, remove the cassette, gently pull out the jammed tape and rewind slack into the cassette with a fingertip before re-inserting.

#### Cutter does not cut cleanly (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/cutter-does-not-cut-cleanly

Replace the cutter unit (TC-4).

#### Want to start a fresh label (Brother PT-D210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d210/trouble/want-to-start-a-fresh-label

Shift + BS → Text&Format → OK.

### Shortcuts

- `Menu` → `1`: File menu
- `Menu` → `2`: Insert a Tab
- `Menu` → `3`: Unit (inch / mm)
- `Menu` → `4`: LCD Contrast (−2 … +2)
- `Menu` → `BS`: Clear (Text & Format, or Text Only)
- `Menu` → `Space`: Language
- `Shift` + `BS`: Clear text and/or format
- `Shift` + `Preview`: Feed about 25 mm (1") of blank tape
- `Shift` + `Print`: Print Options: Numbering or Mirror
- `Shift` + `▶`: Jump cursor to the end of the text
- `Shift` + `◀`: Jump cursor to the start of the text
- `Frame` → number keys → `OK`: Pick a frame directly by its sheet number (01–99)
- `Symbol` → “Basic” or “Pictograph” → `OK` → letter key: Jump straight to a symbol category (see each category for its key)
- `Print` → digit key: Set number of copies (1–9) by typing it
- `Space` (inside any setting): Return that setting to its default (e.g. Label Length → Auto)
- `Esc`: Cancel anything, exit preview or templates
- `Shift` + digit: Type the symbol printed above the digit: ! @ # $ % ' & * ( ) and " on the − key
- `Shift` + `,` / `.` / `;`: Type ? / and :
- letter → `Accent` → `Accent`…: Cycle accented letters (é è ê ë …), `OK` to insert
- `Enter`: New line (2-line label on 9 / 12 mm tape)
- `Esc` / `OK` / `Enter` in preview: Leave the preview
- `Power` off → hold `Shift` + `R` → press `Power`: Factory reset (clears everything; release Power first, then Shift and R)

### Specs

- Tape: Brother TZe laminated tape, 3.5 / 6 / 9 / 12 mm (0.13" / 0.23" / 0.35" / 0.47")
- Print: 180 dpi thermal transfer, 2 lines max (9 & 12 mm tape)
- Text: Up to 80 characters per label (50 in templates), 15-character one-row LCD
- Fonts: 14 fonts · 3 sizes · 3 widths · 10 styles · 4 alignments
- Decorations: 99 frame slots on the sheet (01 is Off, 02 is underline) · 27 templates · 621 symbols in 27 categories
- Memory: 30 saved labels (80 chars each, 2400 total). History keeps the last 7 symbols
- Power: 6 × AAA alkaline (LR03) or Ni-MH (HR03), or AC adapter AD-24ES / AD-24ESA / AD-24ESAW / AD-24ESA-01 / AD-24ESAW-01 (optional)
- Auto power off: After 5 minutes idle. Text & settings survive 3 minutes without power
- Size / weight: 157 × 150 × 68 mm, 490 g without batteries
- Cutter: Manual lever; replacement cutter unit TC-4

## Brother P-touch PT-D610BT
Professional Label Maker with Bluetooth. 900 symbols in 26 categories, 167 frames, 80 templates, 17 fonts, 17 styles, 22 shortcuts, 29 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt

### How-to guides

#### Home Screen: Create Label, Auto Format, File, Settings (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/home

1. Press `Home` (house / Bluetooth key).
2. Use `◀` / `▶` to pick “Create Label”, “Auto Format”, “File” or “Settings”, then `OK`.

Note: Create Label starts a 280-character label. Auto Format holds Templates, Block Layouts and Table Format.

#### Font, size, width, style and alignment (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/attributes

1. For one character: `Shift` + `Fn`, pick the attribute, pick the value, `OK`.
2. For a whole line: put the cursor on that line, then `Shift` + `Fn`. Three bars on the left mean the change applies to that line only.
3. Press `Esc` to return to the text.

Note: 17 fonts, 9 sizes (Auto + 6–48 pt), 5 widths, 17 styles including Vertical / Vertical Bold, 4 alignments. Some fonts are region-locked.

#### Multiple lines (up to 7) (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/two-lines

1. Type line 1.
2. Press `Enter` at the end of the line (a return mark appears).
3. Type the next line. Repeat up to the tape width limit.

Note: 24 mm: 7 lines. 18 mm: 5. 12 mm: 3. 9 mm and 6 mm: 2. 3.5 mm: 1.

#### Text blocks (up to 5) (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/blocks

1. Hold `Shift` and press `Enter` to start a new block to the right of the cursor.
2. Format a block the same way as a line (cursor in the block, then Shift + Fn).

Note: Maximum five blocks per label.

#### Fixed label length (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/length

1. `Fn` → “Length” → `OK`.
2. Pick “Auto” or 30–300 mm (1.2"–12") with `▲` / `▼` or the number keys, then `OK`.

Note: “Text too long” means the text no longer fits. Shorten it or return to Auto (`Space` in the setting).

#### Cut options (Small / Large / Chain / No Cut / Special Tape) (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/cut

1. `Fn` → “Cut Option” → `OK`.
2. Pick “Small Margin” (2 mm), “Large Margin” (25 mm), “Chain”, “No Cut” or “Special Tape”, then `OK`.

Note: The first label still has about 23 mm of lead-in (print head to cutter). After Chain or No Cut, press Shift + Preview to feed and cut the last label.
Note: Use No Cut / Special Tape for fabric iron-on, then cut with scissors.

#### Chain print: many labels, less waste (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/chain

1. `Fn` → “Cut Option” → “Chain” → `OK`.
2. Print each label. After the last one, press `Shift` + `Preview` and choose Feed & Cut.

Note: If you skip the final feed, the last label can be cut short.

#### Print and copies (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/print

1. Press `Print`.
2. Set copies with `▲` / `▼` or the number keys (or `OK` for one).
3. Press `Print` or `OK`.

Note: Do not pull the tape while it is ejecting, and do not block the exit slot.

#### Sequential numbering (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/numbering

1. Type the text including the number.
2. `Shift` + `Print` → “Number” → `OK`.
3. Set the start and end with `◀` / `▶`, then `OK`.
4. Set copies and print.

Note: Up to 99 labels per run.

#### Mirror print (glass and windows) (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/mirror

1. Type the text.
2. `Shift` + `Print` → “Mirror” → `OK`.
3. Press `Print` or `OK`.

Note: Use clear tape so the label reads correctly from the other side of the glass.

#### Preview a label (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/preview

1. Press `Preview`.
2. Scroll with the cursor keys. Shift + a cursor key jumps to that edge.
3. Press `Scale/Zoom` to change magnification.
4. Leave with `Esc`.

#### Feed tape (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/feed

1. `Shift` + `Preview`.
2. Pick “Feed & Cut” or “Feed Only”, then `OK`.

Note: Feed Only is recommended for fabric iron-on tape, which you then cut with scissors.

#### Barcodes (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/barcode

1. `Fn` → “Barcode” → `OK`.
2. Set Protocol, Width (use Large when you can), Under# and C.Digit, then enter the data.
3. Up to five barcodes per label.

Note: Print black on white. “Check no. of digits entered” means the data length does not match the protocol.

#### Table format (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/table

1. `Home` → “Auto Format” → “Table Format” → `OK`.
2. Pick the tape width, then set Rows and Columns.
3. Type each cell, then print or save.

Note: Row limit follows the tape: 7 / 5 / 3 / 2 lines.

#### Save, open, print and mark files (99 slots) (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/files

1. Save: `Fn` → “Save” → pick a slot → `OK`.
2. Open / print / delete / mark: `Home` → “File” → pick a slot → pick the action.
3. Marking stores the file in one of eight colour categories.

Note: 280 characters per file. Files are lost if power is gone for more than two minutes without batteries.

#### Symbol History (last 30) (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/history

1. `Home` → “Settings” → “Symbol History” → “On” or “Off”.
2. With History on, `Symbol` lists the last 30 symbols first.

#### Accented characters (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/accents

1. Type the letter.
2. Press `Accent` and cycle with `Accent` or `▲` / `▼`.
3. Press `OK`.

Note: The set depends on the LCD language. See the Accent table under Symbols.

#### Clear text and/or formatting (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/clear

1. `BS` deletes one character.
2. `Clear` → “Text Only” or “Text & Format” → `OK`.
3. Shift + BS deletes the current line.

#### Tabs (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/tabs

1. Press `Tab` to insert a tab.
2. `Fn` → “Tab Length” → 0–100 mm (0–4.0") → `OK`.

#### Text Reminder (autocomplete) (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/reminder

1. Type a letter and press `OK` to see stored words starting with that letter.
2. `Home` → “Settings” to turn Text Reminder on or off, or to clear its memory.

#### Time stamp and clock (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/clock

1. Set the clock: `Home` → “Settings” → “Set Clock”.
2. Format: “Time & Date Format”.
3. Stamp: “Time Stamp Setting” for Auto/Fixed, Date / D&T / Time / T&D, and optional Forward date.

Note: Keep AA cells in so the clock survives unplugging.

#### Bluetooth (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/bluetooth

1. `Shift` + `Home`, or `Home` → “Settings” → “Bluetooth” → “Bluetooth (On/Off)”.
2. Pair from Brother iPrint&Label or P-touch Editor.

Note: Bluetooth 5.0, SPP / iAP2. The device cannot pair with two hosts at once.

#### Language and units (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/language-unit

1. Language: `Home` → “Settings” → “Language”.
2. Unit: “Settings” → “Unit” → “inch” or “mm”.

#### Display brightness and label-length trim (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/contrast

1. `Home` → “Settings” → “Adjustment” → “Display Brightness” (−2 … +2).
2. “Label Length” trim is −3 … +3 (about 1% of length per step) when a nearly-empty cassette prints short.

#### Label View vs Print Preview (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/input-mode

1. `Home` → “Settings” → “Input Mode” → “Label View” or “Print Preview”.
2. Tape Colour detection (default On) tints Label View to match the cassette.

#### Batteries, adapter and auto power-off (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/power

1. Use 6 × AA alkaline (LR6), all new, same type.
2. Adapter AD-E001A only. Keep batteries in as memory/clock backup.
3. Auto power-off: Settings → Auto Power Off. Battery 5/10/30 min; AC 1/2/4/8 hr.

Note: Power gone for more than two minutes without batteries clears the current text, format and saved files.

#### Change the tape cassette (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/tape

1. Open the cassette cover.
2. Drop the TZe cassette in so the tape runs under the guides and does not catch the print head.
3. Close the cover. If it will not close, lift the release lever first.

Note: Only Brother TZe tapes with the TZe mark. An empty cassette damages the head.

#### Clean the print head and cutter (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/clean

1. Unplug and remove the batteries.
2. Wipe the print head with a dry cotton swab or use cassette TZe-CL4.
3. About once a year, wipe the cutter blade with a cotton swab and isopropyl alcohol. Do not touch the blade.

#### Reset (LCD) (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/howto/reset

1. `Home` → “Settings” → “Reset” → pick a method → `OK` twice.
2. “Reset All Settings” keeps files. “Erase All Content” clears files and keeps settings. “Factory Settings” clears both.

Note: After Reset All Settings or Factory Settings you must set the language again.

### Error messages

#### “Barcode error / Record: / Field:” (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/barcode-error-record-field

Meaning: A transferred database barcode used characters the protocol cannot encode.
Fix: Fix the database field or pick another protocol.

#### “Check no. of digits entered” (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/check-no-of-digits-entered

Meaning: Barcode data length does not match the protocol.
Fix: Enter the required number of digits.

#### “Cutter malfunction” (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/cutter-malfunction

Meaning: Tape is jammed in the cutter.
Fix: Remove the jam. Turn the device off and on before continuing.

#### “Label too long” (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/label-too-long

Meaning: Printed length would exceed 999 mm (39.37").
Fix: Shorten the text.

#### “System error XX” (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/system-error-xx

Meaning: Internal fault.
Fix: Contact Brother Customer Service and quote the number.

#### “Text too long” (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/text-too-long

Meaning: Text is longer than the fixed label length.
Fix: Shorten the text or set Length back to Auto.

### Problems and fixes

#### Nothing prints (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/nothing-prints

Cassette missing, empty or not clicked in; cover open; device off; Bluetooth paired to another host; dirty print head (clean with a swab or TZe-CL4).

#### Tape does not feed / jammed (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/tape-does-not-feed-jammed

Cut off a bent leader. Remove the cassette, clear the jam, feed the tape under the guides, re-insert.

#### Too much blank tape on both sides (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/too-much-blank-tape-on-both-sides

Cut Option → Small Margin or Chain. The first ~23 mm lead-in cannot be removed. After a Chain batch, Shift + Preview → Feed & Cut.

#### LCD blank after power on (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/lcd-blank-after-power-on

Check battery direction, replace all six AA cells, or seat the AD-E001A adapter.

#### LCD in a foreign language (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/lcd-in-a-foreign-language

Settings → Language.

#### Stops while printing (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/stops-while-printing

Striped leader means the cassette is empty. Weak batteries: replace all six or use the adapter.

#### Saved files gone (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/saved-files-gone

Power was off more than two minutes without batteries. Keep AA cells in as backup.

#### Screen locked / keys do nothing (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/screen-locked-keys-do-nothing

Settings → Reset, or unplug and remove batteries for 10 minutes.

#### Barcodes will not scan (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/barcodes-will-not-scan

Use black on white tape and Width = Large.

#### Font will not go larger (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/font-will-not-go-larger

Already at the maximum for this tape, or Length is fixed.

#### Last Chain label cut wrong (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/last-chain-label-cut-wrong

Feed & Cut after the last copy.

#### Firmware update failed (Brother PT-D610BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-d610bt/trouble/firmware-update-failed

Restart and retry. Do not press keys until the Home Screen returns.

### Shortcuts

- `Home` → “Create Label”: Start a new label (up to 280 characters)
- `Home` → “Auto Format”: Templates, Block Layouts and Table Format
- `Home` → “File”: Print, Open, Delete or Mark a saved label (99 slots)
- `Home` → “Settings”: Language, Unit, Auto Power Off, Bluetooth, Tape Colour, Input Mode, Adjustment, Clock, Reset
- `Shift` + `Home`: Toggle Bluetooth on or off from the Home Screen
- `Shift` + `Fn`: Character attributes (Font, Size, Width, Style, Alignment)
- `Fn` → “Frame”: Pick a frame by category or by typing its number
- `Fn` → “Barcode”: Insert a barcode (CODE39, CODE128, EAN, UPC, ITF, CODABAR, GS1-128)
- `Fn` → “Length”: Label length Auto or 30–300 mm (1.2"–12")
- `Fn` → “Cut Option”: Small Margin / Large Margin / Chain / No Cut / Special Tape
- `Fn` → “Tab Length”: Tab length 0–100 mm (0–4.0")
- `Fn` → “Save”: Save the current label to one of 99 file slots
- `Shift` + `Preview`: Feed & Cut or Feed Only
- `Shift` + `Print`: Print Options: Numbering or Mirror
- `Shift` + `◀` / `▶`: Jump to the start / end of the current line
- `Shift` + `▲` / `▼`: Jump to the previous / next block
- `Space` (inside any setting): Return that setting to its default
- `Esc`: Cancel, leave preview, back out of menus
- `Shift` + digit: Type the symbol printed above the digit
- letter → `Accent`: Cycle accented letters, `OK` to insert
- `Enter`: New line (up to 7 lines on 24 mm tape)
- `Print` → digit: Set number of copies (up to 99)

### Specs

- Tape: Brother TZe laminated tape, 3.5 / 6 / 9 / 12 / 18 / 24 mm (0.13" / 0.23" / 0.35" / 0.47" / 0.70" / 0.94")
- Print: Thermal transfer, about 30 mm/s (1.18"/s). Max print height 18.0 mm (0.71") on 24 mm tape
- Text: Up to 280 characters per label, 99 file slots. Colour LCD (320 × 120 dpi)
- Fonts: 17 fonts · 9 sizes (Auto + 6–48 pt) · 5 widths · 17 styles · 4 alignments
- Decorations: 167 printed frames in 5 categories (Brother lists 160) · 37 Auto Format templates · 43 block layouts
- Symbols: 26 categories. 702 individually cropped glyphs + circled 1–99 + boxed 1–99 (Brother lists 900)
- Memory: 99 saved labels, 280 characters each. Symbol History stores the last 30 symbols
- Power: 6 × AA alkaline (LR6). AC adapter AD-E001A. Batteries back up memory
- Auto power off: Battery: 5 / 10 / 30 min. AC adapter: 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 hr
- Size / weight: 202 × 87 × 199 mm (7.95" × 3.42" × 7.83"), about 990 g without batteries and cassette
- Cutter: Automatic full cutter. Clean the blade about once a year with isopropyl alcohol
- Wireless: Bluetooth 5.0 (SPP / iAP2). USB 2.0 Full Speed, Micro-B

## NIIMBOT D110
Smart Label Printer (US SKU D110_M). 17 symbols in 6 categories, 5 shortcuts, 8 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110

### How-to guides

#### Power on and off (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/howto/power

1. Press and hold the `Power` button for three seconds to power on (the button-functions table also lists hold 2–3 seconds for on or off).
2. Hold `Power` 2–3 seconds again to power off.

Note: If the device cannot be turned on, charge for one hour.

#### Load the label paper (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/howto/load-paper

1. Slide the door-open button (OPEN) to the left to open the paper compartment.
2. Place the label roll in the compartment with the printing surface face down and the first label protruding from the paper outlet.
3. Close the paper compartment.

Note: The cutting blade is on the lid. Tear against it after printing.
Note: ※ The label paper should be inserted with the printing side face down in the paper compartment.

#### Download NIIMBOT or NIIM (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/howto/apps

1. For commercial or industrial work, download the NIIMBOT app (industry templates, data import, batch printing).
2. For home storage or personal projects, download the NIIM app (creative icons and household templates).
3. Get either app from the Apple App Store or Google Play.

Note: The guide calls both “Design & Print APP, easy to download and use”.

#### Connect over Bluetooth and print (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/howto/connect

1. Once the app is downloaded, turn on the phone's Bluetooth.
2. Open the app and search for Bluetooth devices to connect to.
3. If it asks for a PIN, enter “0000” or “1234”, then press OK.
4. Once connected, go to the Drawing Board.

Note: Location permissions may need to be enabled on Android phones.
Note: Illustrations of software interfaces in this guide are for reference only.

#### Power-button actions (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/howto/button

1. Hold 2–3 seconds: on or off.
2. Quick press: set in the app to “Don't feed paper”, “Print current time” or “Print history”.
3. Press twice: print a testing page.

#### Charge the printer (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/howto/charge

1. Plug the USB Type-C cable into the port on the top (next to the Power Indicator light).
2. Input is 5 V DC, 1 A. Charging time is 3–4 hours.
3. Watch the Power Indicator light: white blinking slowly = charging; white solid = fully charged and connected to power; white flashing quickly = low battery.

Note: If you use a power adapter, it must be safe, compliant, and meet the standards.
Note: If the device cannot be turned on, charge for one hour.

#### Read the indicator lights (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/howto/indicators

1. Front Indicator light (around the power button): blue solid = powered on but not connected; blue flashing quickly = upgrading firmware; green solid = Bluetooth connected; green flashing quickly = printing; red solid = device fault.
2. Top Power Indicator light: white blinking slowly = charging; white solid = fully charged and connected to power; white flashing quickly = low battery.

#### Safety precautions (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/howto/safety

1. Do not disassemble the product yourself (no returns or exchanges for disassembled products).
2. Do not use corrosive chemical products or cleaners to wipe the product.
3. Do not use the product near flammable substances (gas stations, fuel depots, etc.).
4. Keep the product and accessories away from children, or use only under a guardian.
5. If the product enters water, or malfunctions, disconnect it from power immediately.
6. Do not replace the battery yourself. Incorrect replacement can explode.
7. If you notice smoke or a smell from the product or adapter, disconnect immediately and avoid burns.

Note: Buy the version that matches your region from the NIIMBOT official store or an authorized sales agent.

### Error messages

#### “Blue · solid” (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/blue-solid

Meaning: Powered on but not connected.
Fix: Open the NIIM or NIIMBOT app and connect over Bluetooth.

#### “Blue · flashing quickly” (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/blue-flashing-quickly

Meaning: Upgrading firmware.
Fix: Wait until the light stops flashing quickly.

#### “Green · solid” (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/green-solid

Meaning: Bluetooth connected.
Fix: Go to the Drawing Board and print.

#### “Green · flashing quickly” (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/green-flashing-quickly

Meaning: Printing.
Fix: Wait for the job to finish, then tear against the cutting blade.

#### “Red · solid” (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/red-solid

Meaning: Device fault.
Fix: Disconnect power. Do not keep using a malfunctioning device. Contact NIIMBOT support if it persists.

#### “White · blinking slowly” (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/white-blinking-slowly

Meaning: Charging.
Fix: Leave it plugged in (3–4 hours from empty).

#### “White · solid” (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/white-solid

Meaning: Fully charged and connected to power.
Fix: You can unplug or keep it on the adapter.

#### “White · flashing quickly” (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/white-flashing-quickly

Meaning: Low battery.
Fix: Charge via USB Type-C (5 V DC, 1 A).

### Problems and fixes

#### Device cannot be turned on (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/device-cannot-be-turned-on

Charge for one hour, then hold `Power` for three seconds.

#### Phone cannot find the printer (NIIMBOT D110)

Turn the printer on, enable Bluetooth, and on Android enable location permission. If a PIN is requested, try 0000 or 1234.

#### Labels print blank or very faint (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/labels-print-blank-or-very-faint

Reload the roll with the printing surface face down and the first label in the outlet. Direct thermal paper only.

#### Red indicator stays on (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/red-indicator-stays-on

Device fault. Disconnect from power. Do not disassemble. Contact service@niimbot.com.

#### White light flashes quickly (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/white-light-flashes-quickly

Low battery. Charge with the USB Type-C cable.

#### Product entered water (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/product-entered-water

Immediately disconnect from the power source.

#### Smoke or a smell from the printer or adapter (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/smoke-or-a-smell-from-the-printer-or-adapter

Disconnect the power adapter immediately, taking care to avoid burns.

#### Considering opening the case or replacing the battery (NIIMBOT D110)
https://labelarium.com/d/niimbot-d110/trouble/considering-opening-the-case-or-replacing-the-battery

Do not. Disassembled units are not accepted for return or exchange; incorrect battery replacement can explode.

### Shortcuts

- hold `Power` 2–3 seconds: Power on or off
- quick press `Power`: Don't feed paper, print current time, or print history (set in the app)
- press `Power` twice: Print testing page
- Bluetooth PIN “0000” or “1234”: If the phone asks for a PIN while pairing
- Android location permission: Turn on location so the app can search for Bluetooth devices

- Text: Designed in the NIIM or NIIMBOT app Drawing Board. This guide does not list a character limit.
- Fonts: Chosen in the app. This getting-started guide does not print a font catalog.
- Decorations: Icons and templates live in the NIIM / NIIMBOT apps. This guide does not print those catalogs.
- Memory: Not specified. Quick press can be set in the app to “Print history”.
- Power: 1500 mAh battery; USB Type-C charge, 5 V DC 1 A; 3–4 hours to charge
- Auto power off: Not specified in this guide
- Size / weight: 98 × 76 × 30 mm, 149 g
- Cutter: Manual cutting blade on the paper compartment lid
- Model: NIIMBOT D110_M (cover title: NIIMBOT D110)
- Connectivity: Bluetooth 2402–2480 MHz, BLE 2402–2480 MHz, transmit power 4 dBm maximum
- NFC: 13.56 MHz

## Phomemo M110
Bluetooth Portable Thermal Business Label Maker. 8 shortcuts, 9 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110

### How-to guides

#### What is in the box (Phomemo M110)
https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110/howto/unbox

1. Support Center: Phomemo M110 printer × 1; 1½" × 1⅛" (40 × 30 mm) 100-label roll × 1 (already inside. Open the cover and pull it out a little so the printer senses it); USB cable × 1; user manual × 1.
2. Setup guide also lists a warranty card and calls the roll a sample of 40 mm × 30 mm labels.

Note: Product registration is no longer necessary. Keep proof of purchase for warranty.

#### Charge the printer (Phomemo M110)
https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110/howto/charge

1. Before first use, connect the included USB cable to a power source.
2. Wait until the indicator is green. Red = charging; green = charged.

Note: Setup guide: about 2–3 hours to charge; 1200 mAh battery, up to 4–5 hours of continuous printing.
Note: Support Center: about 1.5 hours to refill; about 4 hours continuous. The battery is built-in and not user-replaceable.

#### Load thermal labels (Phomemo M110)
https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110/howto/load

1. Press the side button to open the top cover.
2. Insert the label roll with the adhesive side facing out.
3. Feed the label through the paper guide.
4. Close the lid securely.
5. Keep the paper aligned with the sensor. If the roll was pre-loaded, pull the end out a little so the printer senses it.

Note: Width support listed by Phomemo: 20–50 mm. In-box sample is 40 × 30 mm.

#### Install Print Master and connect (Phomemo M110)
https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110/howto/app

1. Install Print Master: iOS App Store or Android Google Play, or the Support Center / drivers hub.
2. Turn on Bluetooth on the phone.
3. Open Print Master and allow permissions.
4. Tap `Connect Device` → select “M110”.

Note: MUST connect from Print Master, NOT from the phone’s Bluetooth settings. Otherwise pairing fails.
Note: The app remembers the device for later sessions.

#### Print the first label (Phomemo M110)
https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110/howto/print

1. Open Print Master (printer already connected).
2. Choose or create a template (setup guide examples: price tag, barcode, name label).
3. Customise text, icons and layout. Tools on the official screenshot include `Text`, `Code`, `Icon`, `Frames`, `Form`, `Picture`, `Copy`, `Scan`, `Time`.
4. Tap `Print`. The label prints in seconds.

Note: 203 dpi. Good for retail, logistics, food packaging and similar uses, per the setup guide.

#### Barcodes and QR codes (Phomemo M110)
https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110/howto/barcode

1. In Print Master, use `Code` (and related barcode/QR tools in the app).
2. Support Center: the software can create Code128, Code39, Codabar, EAN-8, EAN-13 and similar codes, plus QR codes.

Note: Setup guide FAQ: generate and print barcodes and QR codes directly from the app.

#### Windows, Mac and Chrome OS (Phomemo M110)
https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110/howto/computer

1. Support Center: download Phomemo Setup Utilities for Windows or Mac from the drivers hub. Chrome OS is listed on the same page.
2. Watch the official videos on that page: Print Master on phones; Labelife driver on Windows 10; Labelife on Mac; Labelife Chrome extension.
3. Setup guide FAQ: the M110 is primarily mobile-focused; you can connect via USB for Windows with driver support.

Note: Listed OS: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 (32- and 64-bit), Windows 11 (64-bit); macOS 10.14, 10.15, 10.11, 12; Chrome OS.
Note: This pack does not document Labelife menus. Phomemo has not published that catalog on these two pages.

#### How long thermal labels last (Phomemo M110)
https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110/howto/paper

1. Support Center: store paper up to 10 years away from light, in the dark, at normal temperature. In use, avoid high temperature and sun.
2. Setup guide FAQ: with proper storage, printed thermal labels last 1–2 years depending on the environment.

Note: The two official pages give different figures (storage vs printed life). This pack keeps both.

#### Contact Phomemo (Phomemo M110)
https://labelarium.com/d/phomemo-m110/howto/support

1. E-mail: vip@phomemo.com
2. Web: phomemo.com/support
3. Phone: +1 855 957 5321, Mon–Fri 9:00–5:00 EDT (US).

Note: Support Center: they will help, or repair or replace. Keep proof of purchase.
