## Brother P-touch CUBE Plus PT-P710BT
Bluetooth cube printer for phones and P-touch Editor. 36 symbols in 6 categories, 3 styles, 17 shortcuts, 15 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt

### How-to guides

#### Insert a TZe tape cassette (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/tape

1. Place your fingers on the Tape Exit Slot.
2. Open the Cassette Cover by pulling the Tape Exit Slot to the left.
3. Confirm the tape points at the Tape Exit Slot and press the cassette in until it locks. The end of the tape must run under the Tape Guide. Pull slack out if needed.
4. Close the Cassette Cover.

Note: When inserting or removing a cassette, keep the tape from catching on the printer.
Note: Never print with an empty cassette. It damages the Print Head.
Note: Only Brother TZe cassettes.

#### Charge the Li-ion battery (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/charge

1. First time only: pull out the protective sheet inside the cassette bay.
2. Connect the included USB cable to the printer and to a computer USB port (5 V DC, 0.5–2 A) or to a USB AC adapter (not included) of the same rating.
3. Charge until the Battery LED turns off.

Note: Charge at 10–35 °C (50–95 °F) or the Battery LED stays lit and the cell will not charge.
Note: Printing or feeding while charging can pause the charge; it resumes when the job ends.
Note: Use the included USB cable.
Note: If charging from a computer, leave the computer on.
Note: Store long-term at 10–35 °C and charge once every six months.

#### Remove the battery for replacement or disposal (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/battery

1. Turn the printer off.
2. Open the Cassette Cover.
3. Remove the two screws from the Battery Cover with a flat-bladed screwdriver.
4. Lift out the battery.
5. To refit: contacts against the contacts in the compartment, replace the cover, tighten the screws, close the Cassette Cover.

Note: DANGER: do not dispose of the battery with household waste.
Note: Cover the contacts with cellophane tape before storing or discarding.
Note: Observe local collection rules.

#### Turn power on or off (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/power

1. On: press `Power`.
2. Off: press and hold `Power` until the Power LED turns off.

#### Pair with a phone or tablet (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/pair

1. Turn the printer on.
2. On the phone: Settings → turn Bluetooth on.
3. Select PT-P710BT**** (**** = last four digits of the serial number inside the Cassette Cover, under the cassette).
4. If asked for a PIN, enter “0000”.
5. Open iPrint&Label or P-touch Design&Print 2 and select this printer.

Note: The cube does not support Wi-Fi.
Note: If it is not found, it may already be paired with another device. Turn that device's Bluetooth off, or power-cycle the printer.
Note: If it is not found, make sure it is not in sleep mode.
Note: Keep the phone close; microwaves and other radio sources can block the link.

#### Print from a mobile device (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/print-mobile

1. Download iPrint&Label (business: barcodes, equipment, folder tabs) or P-touch Design&Print 2 (home and work styles) from the App Store or Google Play.
2. Pair as above.
3. Design the label in the app and print.
4. The first label of a session feeds about 25 mm (1") of blank tape. Press `Power` twice quickly to feed and cut if you need to.

Note: iPrint&Label and Design&Print 2 QR codes from the guide are in Symbols → Mobile apps.

#### Print from a Windows or Mac computer (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/print-computer

1. Visit install.brother and install the printer driver and P-touch Editor.
2. Connect the included USB cable. Computers cannot print over Bluetooth on this model, and there is no Wi-Fi.
3. Windows: double-click the P-touch Editor icon, pick Express, Professional or Snap, then print.
4. Mac: Applications → P-touch Editor, pick a new template or a template category, then print.

Note: Express: quick text and images. Professional: advanced tools. Snap: a palette that stays on screen (capture, drag-and-drop, print text).
Note: Cable Labeling Wizard is available for electrical equipment labels.

#### Auto Cut, Chain Printing, Special tape, Mirror (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/autocut-chain

1. In P-touch Editor print settings, tick the options you need (several can be on at once).
2. “Auto Cut”: cuts each label.
3. “Chain Printing”: does not cut the last label, to save tape.
4. “Special tape”: feeds for a manual cut. Use with fabric and extra-strength tapes.
5. “Mirror Printing”: prints reversed. Use clear tape on glass so it reads from the other side.

Note: Press `Power` twice quickly to feed and cut if Auto Cut is off.

#### The 25 mm blank lead-in (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/lead-in

1. The first label of a session always feeds about 25 mm (1") of blank tape. That is the laminate layer, not a setting you can zero out.
2. Chain Printing (do not cut the last label) and the app's margin controls reduce wasted tape on later labels.

Note: Most TZe labels have a clear laminate top layer. Adding that layer is why the lead-in exists.

#### Peel the backing (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/peel

1. Some tapes have a pre-cut backing.
2. Fold the label lengthwise with the text facing in so the backing splits.
3. Peel each half.

#### Printer Setting Tool (Windows / Mac) (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/settings-tool

1. Connect USB. Start Printer Setting Tool (Windows: Start → Brother → Printer Setting Tool; Mac: Applications → Brother → Printer Setting Tool).
2. Confirm the printer name next to Printer.
3. Windows: Device Settings. Mac: a Settings tab.
4. Set Auto Power On, Auto Power Off, Auto Power Off (Li-ion), Contents, Length Adjustment.
5. Apply, then Exit. Do not start another job while settings are changing.

Note: File → Export / Import copies the same settings onto more PT-P710BT units.

#### Update software and firmware (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/update

1. Close other Brother applications.
2. Software (Windows): double-click P-touch Update Software → Computer software update → pick printer and language → Install.
3. Firmware: power on, USB connected → P-touch Update Software → Machine update → confirm the machine is connected → Transfer → Start.
4. Mac software: see support.brother.com. Firmware path: Applications → P-touch Update Software → Machine update.

Note: Do not power off or unplug USB during a firmware transfer.

#### Clean the Print Head (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/clean-head

1. Streaks or poor characters usually mean a dirty head.
2. Option A: insert TZe-CL4 Head Cleaning Tape and press `Power` twice quickly. About 25 mm feeds per cycle. Repeat up to three times.
3. Option B: power off, unplug USB, and wipe the head with a dry cotton swab.

Note: CAUTION: do not touch the Print Head. It can burn.
Note: If three cleaning-tape cycles do not help, contact Brother.

#### Clean the tape cutter (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/clean-cutter

1. Tape adhesive dulls the blade and can jam the cutter.
2. Wipe the blades with a cotton swab moistened with ethanol or isopropyl alcohol.

Note: CAUTION: do not touch or put fingers into the cutter blade.
Note: Disconnect USB and power off before any maintenance. Wipe the exterior with a soft dry cloth (or slightly damp). No benzene, thinner or alcohol on the case.

#### Cancel a print job (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/howto/cancel

1. Make sure the printer is on.
2. Lightly press `Power`.

### Error messages

#### “Power LED red, flashing twice per second then off 1 s” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/power-led-red-flashing-twice-per-second-then-off-1-s

Meaning: Battery failure.
Fix: Lightly press `Power`. If it continues, replace the battery.

#### “Power LED red, flashing 1 s: no / wrong / incompatible cassette” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/power-led-red-flashing-1-s-no-wrong-incompatible-cassette

Meaning: No cassette, incorrect cassette, or incompatible cassette.
Fix: Lightly press `Power`. Insert a correct TZe cassette.

#### “Power LED red, flashing 1 s: insufficient charge” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/power-led-red-flashing-1-s-insufficient-charge

Meaning: Battery too low, or the protective sheet is still in place.
Fix: Lightly press `Power`. Remove the protective sheet. Charge the battery.

#### “Power LED red, flashing 1 s: high temperature” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/power-led-red-flashing-1-s-high-temperature

Meaning: Printer too hot.
Fix: Lightly press `Power`. Wait until the Power LED is green, then retry.

#### “Power LED red, flashing 1 s: transmission error” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/power-led-red-flashing-1-s-transmission-error

Meaning: Bluetooth or USB link dropped.
Fix: Restart the printer. Phone: pair again. Computer: reseat the USB cable or try another USB port.

#### “Power LED red, flashing 1 s: cutter error” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/power-led-red-flashing-1-s-cutter-error

Meaning: Cutter jammed or failed.
Fix: Restart the printer. Clean the cutter if adhesive has built up.

#### “Power LED red, lit: program transfer failure” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/power-led-red-lit-program-transfer-failure

Meaning: Firmware / program transfer failed.
Fix: Transfer the program again. If it continues, contact Brother.

#### “Power LED red, flashing 0.3 s: system error” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/power-led-red-flashing-0-3-s-system-error

Meaning: Internal fault.
Fix: Contact Brother. The flash pattern may change if you touch `Power`.

#### “Battery LED flashing 0.5 s” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/battery-led-flashing-0-5-s

Meaning: Insufficient charge or battery failure.
Fix: See the Power LED table above.

#### “Battery LED stays lit while charging” (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/battery-led-stays-lit-while-charging

Meaning: Too cold or too hot to charge (outside 10–35 °C).
Fix: Move to 10–35 °C (50–95 °F).

### Problems and fixes

#### The printer does not print (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/the-printer-does-not-print

Cassette seated and not empty; cover closed; charge not low; printer on; phone not asleep; Bluetooth on; this printer selected in the P-touch app; not paired to another device; phone close by; no microwave nearby. From a computer: official driver, included USB cable, label not blank.

#### Tape does not feed, or gets stuck inside (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/tape-does-not-feed-or-gets-stuck-inside

If the tape is bent, cut off the bent part. If jammed, remove the cassette, pull the jam out and cut it. End of tape must sit in the Tape Guide and point at the Tape Exit Slot. Reseat the cassette.

#### A tape-jam error will not clear (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/a-tape-jam-error-will-not-clear

Contact Brother customer service.

#### A horizontal gap runs through the printed label (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/a-horizontal-gap-runs-through-the-printed-label

Dirty Print Head. See How-to: Clean the Print Head.

#### An error in a mobile app (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/an-error-in-a-mobile-app

App settings → Support page → FAQs & Troubleshooting.

#### I want to cancel printing (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/i-want-to-cancel-printing

Printer on, then lightly press `Power`.

#### Ink ribbon is separated from the ink roller (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/ink-ribbon-is-separated-from-the-ink-roller

If the ribbon is broken, replace the cassette. If not, leave the tape uncut, remove the cassette, and wind the loose ribbon back onto the spool.

#### Printer stops while printing / striped tape appears (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/printer-stops-while-printing-striped-tape-appears

You have reached the end of the tape. Insert a new cassette. Striped tape means empty.

#### Tape is not cut automatically (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/tape-is-not-cut-automatically

Select Auto Cut. Special tapes: cut by hand.

#### Printed barcodes or QR codes cannot be read (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/printed-barcodes-or-qr-codes-cannot-be-read

Try another scanner or QR app. Use black-on-white tape. Enlarge the code in the app if you can.

#### About 25 mm (1") of blank tape before each label (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/about-25-mm-1-of-blank-tape-before-each-label

Laminate lead-in. Reduce it with the app margin setting or by not cutting the last label (Chain Printing). The first lead-in cannot be removed.

#### Cannot turn on, or it powers off when I print (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/cannot-turn-on-or-it-powers-off-when-i-print

Charge the battery. Remove the protective sheet (see Insert a TZe tape cassette).

#### Battery will not charge (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/battery-will-not-charge

Unplug and reconnect USB. Remove the protective sheet. Charge only at 10–35 °C.

#### Battery life is short even when fully charged (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/battery-life-is-short-even-when-fully-charged

The cell may be worn out. Fit a new PA-BT-005.

#### Check I have the latest software (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/check-i-have-the-latest-software

Windows: P-touch Update Software. Mac: support.brother.com.

#### White or gold objects print poorly / small text is fuzzy (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/white-or-gold-objects-print-poorly-small-text-is-fuzzy

The UG warns that white and gold objects may not print clearly, small text is less sharp than on screen, and print can differ from the preview (the screen is higher resolution than 180 dpi).

#### Label will not stick (Brother PT-P710BT)
https://labelarium.com/d/brother-pt-p710bt/trouble/label-will-not-stick

Surface wet, dirty or uneven. For rough/textured surfaces use Extra Strength Adhesive Tape. Read the instructions that come with fabric and other special tapes.

### Shortcuts

- `Power`: Power on
- hold `Power` until Power LED off: Power off
- `Power` `Power` (twice quickly): Feed about 25 mm (1") and cut
- light `Power`: Cancel the current print, or clear some LED errors
- Bluetooth PIN “0000”: Enter 0000 if the phone asks for a PIN while pairing
- phone Settings → Bluetooth → “PT-P710BT****”: Pair. **** is the last four digits of the serial number inside the Cassette Cover
- P-touch Editor → Auto Cut: Cut each label automatically
- P-touch Editor → Chain Printing: Save tape by not cutting the last label
- P-touch Editor → Special tape: Feed for a manual cut (fabric / extra-strength tapes)
- P-touch Editor → Mirror Printing: Print reversed, for the inside of glass
- Printer Setting Tool → Auto Power On: Turn on automatically when USB power is connected
- Printer Setting Tool → Auto Power Off / Auto Power Off (Li-ion): Idle timeout on adapter power / on battery
- Printer Setting Tool → Length Adjustment: Match printed length to the length shown on the computer
- Printer Setting Tool → File → Export / Import: Copy the same settings onto more PT-P710BT units
- P-touch Update Software → Computer software update: Update P-touch Editor and related PC software
- P-touch Update Software → Machine update: Update printer firmware over USB
- install.brother: Install the printer driver and P-touch Editor

### Specs

- Tape: Brother TZe laminated tape, 3.5 / 6 / 9 / 12 / 18 / 24 mm (0.13" / 0.23" / 0.35" / 0.47" / 0.70" / 0.94"). Head cleaning cassette TZe-CL4
- Print: Thermal transfer. Brother lists 180 dpi standard / 180 × 360 dpi high-resolution (from a computer), up to 20 mm/s, max print width 18 mm on 24 mm tape. Auto cutter
- Text: No on-device keyboard or LCD. Compose in iPrint&Label, P-touch Design&Print 2, or P-touch Editor. Printed length can differ from the on-screen preview
- Fonts: Chosen in the app / P-touch Editor (not stored on the printer). This guide does not print a typeface catalog
- Decorations: No on-device frames, templates or symbol sheet. Frames, barcodes and layouts live in the apps. This pack catalogs 36 cells cropped from the UG
- Memory: No D210-style file slots on the printer. Save layouts in the app or P-touch Editor
- Power: Rechargeable Li-ion PA-BT-005. Charge over the included USB cable from a computer USB port or a USB AC adapter (not included), 5 V DC, 0.5–2 A. Charge 10–35 °C (50–95 °F)
- Auto power: Auto Power On / Auto Power Off / Auto Power Off (Li-ion) are set in the Printer Setting Tool, not with a fixed idle timer on the cube
- Size / weight: 128 × 67 × 128 mm (5" × 2.6" × 5"), about 640 g with battery
- Cutter: Automatic full cut. `Power` twice quickly feeds about 25 mm (1") and cuts. Special tapes: use Special tape (manual cut)

## DYMO LabelManager 160
Portable Label Maker. 228 symbols in 2 categories, 5 frames, Default typeface, 4 styles, 15 shortcuts, 16 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160

### How-to guides

#### Print your first label (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/first-label

1. Press `Power` to turn on the label maker.
2. The first time, select the language and press `OK`, then select the cassette width and press `OK`.
3. Type the text.
4. Press `Print`.
5. Press the cutter button.
6. Peel the split backing: pinch the label lengthwise toward the printed side so the backing separates, then peel.

Note: Visit www.dymo.com/register to register the serial number (inside the back cover).

#### Two-line labels (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/two-lines

1. Type line 1.
2. Press `Return`. A return mark appears on the LCD (it is not printed).
3. Type line 2. Press `Print`.

Note: Maximum two lines. Only one line will print on 6 mm (1/4") tape. “Too many lines!” if you try more.

#### Vertical labels (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/vertical

1. Press `Vertical`.
2. Type the text.
3. Press `Print`.

Note: On two-line vertical labels, line 2 prints after line 1. Underline does not print on a vertical label.

#### Change the font size (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/size

1. Press `Size` (the AA key) until the size you want is shown.

Note: 6 mm tape: 8, 10, 12 pt. 9 mm: 8, 10, 12, 16, 20 pt. 12 mm: 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 24 pt. Size applies to the whole label.

#### Bold and italic (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/style

1. Press `B` to add or remove bold.
2. Press `I` to add or remove italic.

Note: The two can be combined. They apply to letters and symbols, not to clip art. The LCD B / I indicators light when a style is on.

#### Box and underline styles (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/box

1. Press `Box` until the style is shown on the LCD.

Note: Five styles (see Frames). Underline or box, not both.

#### Insert clip art (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/clipart

1. Press `Menu`.
2. `▲` / `▼` to “Clip Art” → `OK`.
3. Navigate to the image → `OK`.

Note: 105 images, printed on page 9. Positions in this app match that table, left to right, top to bottom.

#### Insert a symbol (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/symbol

1. Press `Menu`.
2. `▲` / `▼` to “Symbols” → `OK`.
3. Navigate to the symbol → `OK`.
4. Punctuation only: press `.,#` instead of `Menu`.

Note: 123 symbols on page 9 (two grey cells on the sheet are empty and are not in the set).

#### Accented characters (à á â ã ä …) (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/accents

1. Press `Accent` then the letter, or press and hold the letter.
2. Navigate to the variant → `OK`.

Note: The guide only prints the a-series example (à á â ã ä and so on). Other letters have their own variants on the device.

#### Upper and lower case (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/caps

1. Press `Caps` to toggle. Default is Caps on.
2. The LCD uppercase or lowercase indicator shows the current mode.

#### Language and label width (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/menu-settings

1. Press `Menu` until the Settings tab is selected.
2. Choose language or label width, then `OK`.

Note: You are asked for language and width the first time you power on, and again whenever you change the cassette.

#### Insert or change the D1 cassette (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/cassette

1. Lift the label cassette cover.
2. Make sure the label and ribbon are taut across the mouth of the cassette and the label passes between the label guides. Turn the ribbon rewind spool clockwise if needed.
3. Insert the cassette until it clicks. Close the cover.
4. Select the new label width when prompted.

Note: The cutter blade is extremely sharp. Do not press the cutter button while changing cassettes. Use DYMO D1 cassettes only.

#### Batteries and optional adapter (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/batteries

1. Press the thumb latch on the back to open the battery cover.
2. Insert six AAA alkaline cells following the + / − markings. Replace the cover.
3. Optional adapter: plug DSA-18PFM-09 Fc 090200 into the connector on the top, then into a wall outlet. The adapter disconnects the batteries as a power source.

Note: Do not mix old and new cells, or alkaline with rechargeable. Remove the batteries if the maker will sit unused for a long time. Text is lost if batteries come out and the adapter is unplugged.

#### Clean the cutter and print head (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/clean

1. Remove the cassette.
2. Cutter: press and hold the cutter button to expose the blade. Wipe both sides with a cotton ball and alcohol.
3. Print head: take the cleaning tool from inside the cassette cover (or contact DYMO if it is missing) and wipe the padded side gently across the head.

Note: Clean the cutter each time you replace the cassette. The blade is extremely sharp.

#### Peel the split backing (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/peel

1. Find the split on the backing.
2. Pinch the label lengthwise, folding toward the printed side, so the backing separates.
3. Peel the backing away.

#### Auto power-off and memory (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/howto/power

1. The maker turns off after two idle minutes.
2. Text and formatting come back when you turn it on, as long as batteries or the adapter still supply power.

Note: If batteries are removed and the adapter is disconnected, the current label is lost.

### Error messages

#### “Printing...” (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/printing

Meaning: The label is printing.
Fix: No action. The message disappears when printing finishes.

#### “Too many characters!” (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/too-many-characters

Meaning: The text buffer is full (the guide does not state a character count).
Fix: Delete some characters. Additional characters cannot be added.

#### “Too many lines!” (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/too-many-lines

Meaning: More lines than this tape width allows.
Fix: Delete a line, or insert a wider cassette. 6 mm (1/4") = one line; 9 mm and 12 mm = two lines max.

#### “Battery low” (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/battery-low

Meaning: Batteries are weak. The LCD may also show a battery icon.
Fix: Replace all six AAA cells, or connect the optional 9 V adapter.

#### “Insert cassette!” (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/insert-cassette

Meaning: No label cassette is inserted.
Fix: Insert a DYMO D1 cassette and select its width when prompted.

#### “Label jam!” (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/label-jam

Meaning: The motor stalled because of a jammed label.
Fix: Remove the jam and replace the cassette. Clean the cutter blade.

### Problems and fixes

#### No display (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/no-display

Make sure the label maker is on. Replace the batteries or connect the optional adapter.

#### Poor print quality (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/poor-print-quality

Replace batteries or use the adapter. Check the cassette is seated. Clean the print head. Try a new cassette.

#### Poor cutter performance (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/poor-cutter-performance

Clean the cutter blade with alcohol. See Caring for Your Label Maker in the user guide.

#### How do I remove the backing from the label? (DYMO LM160)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm160/trouble/how-do-i-remove-the-backing-from-the-label

DYMO labels have a split back. Pinch lengthwise toward the printed side so the backing separates, then peel.

### Shortcuts

- `.,#`: Jump to punctuation symbols
- `Menu`: Open Symbols/Clip Art, or toggle to Settings (language and label width)
- `Menu` → “Clip Art” → `OK`: Browse the 105 clip-art images
- `Menu` → “Symbols” → `OK`: Browse the 123 symbols
- `Accent` then a letter: Show accent variants of that letter; `OK` inserts
- Hold a letter key: Same accent variants as `Accent`
- `Size` (AA): Cycle font size
- `B`: Toggle bold
- `I`: Toggle italic
- `Box`: Cycle underline and box styles
- `Vertical`: Toggle vertical text
- Hold `Backspace`: Delete quickly to the left of the cursor
- `Cancel`: Leave a menu or cancel printing
- `Return`: Second line (9 mm / 12 mm tape)
- `Caps`: Toggle upper / lower case (default Caps on)

### Specs

- Tape: DYMO D1 label cassettes, 6 / 9 / 12 mm (1/4" / 3/8" / 1/2")
- Print: Thermal transfer, 180 dpi, 12 mm/s. Manual cutter button
- Text: Graphical LCD. Buffer limit shown as “Too many characters!”. Last label is remembered while power remains
- Fonts: 1 typeface · 6 sizes (8–24 pt, depends on tape width) · bold and italic (combinable) · vertical
- Decorations: 5 box/underline styles · 105 clip-art images · 123 symbols (228 together, as printed on page 9)
- Memory: Current label text and formatting survive power-off. Lost if batteries are removed and the adapter is unplugged
- Power: 6 × AAA alkaline, or optional adapter DSA-18PFM-09 Fc 090200 (9 V, 2 A) from Dee Van Enterprise Co., Ltd.
- Auto power off: After 2 minutes idle
- Size / weight: 203 × 118 × 49 mm, 350 g without batteries (manufacturer datasheet)
- Cutter: Manual cutter button. Clean the blade with alcohol when you change the cassette

## DYMO LabelManager 280
Rechargeable Portable Label Maker. 221 symbols in 2 categories, 8 frames, 3 fonts, 7 styles, 17 shortcuts, 20 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280

### How-to guides

#### First-time setup (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/first

1. Press `On/Off`.
2. Select the language → `OK`.
3. Select inches or mm → `OK`.
4. Select the width of the cassette that is in the maker → `OK`.

Note: You are asked for the cassette width every time you insert tape, because some features depend on it. You can change language, units and width later under `Menu` → Settings.

#### Insert a D1 tape cassette (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/tape

1. Lift the cassette cover.
2. Make sure the tape and ribbon are taut across the mouth of the cassette and the tape runs between the label guides. Turn the ribbon rewind spool clockwise if needed.
3. Insert the cassette until it clicks.
4. Close the cover.
5. When prompted, set the label width to match the cassette.

Note: Cutter blade is extremely sharp. Keep fingers away and do not press the cutter while changing tape.
Note: 6 / 9 / 12 mm (1/4" / 3/8" / 1/2") DYMO D1 cassettes.

#### Battery pack and charging (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/battery

1. Slide the battery-compartment cover off (adapter unplugged).
2. Insert the Li-ion pack and replace the cover.
3. Plug the charging adapter into the top jack, then into the wall.
4. Charge about 3 hours for a full charge. After about 10 minutes of charging you can print.

Note: Use only adapter DSA-6PFG-12 Fc 120050 (12 V / 0.5 A). The adapter cannot power the maker; it only charges the pack.
Note: Remove the pack if the maker will sit unused for a long time.
Note: Stop charging if it is not finished within three hours. Charge only at +10 °C to 35 °C.

#### Font type, size and style (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/font

1. Font type: `Menu` → Format → `OK` → Font → `OK` → `▲` / `▼` to Basic, Serif or Fun → `OK`.
2. Size: press `AAA`, or `Menu` → Format → the current size → `OK` → `◀` / `▶` to 8 / 10 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 pt → `OK`.
3. Style: `Menu` → Format → Style → `OK` → `▲` / `▼` to the style → `OK`. Or toggle `B`, `I`, `U` and `Vertical` directly.

Note: The guide prints seven styles (Normal, Bold, Italic, Underline, Vertical, Outline, Shadow) even though the sentence says “six”.
Note: Point size applies to the whole label. Available sizes depend on tape width and line count.
Note: Underline does not print on a vertical label. On multi-line labels each line is underlined.

#### Add a border (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/border

1. `Menu` → Format → `OK` → Borders → `OK`.
2. `▲` / `▼` to one of the eight styles → `OK`.

Note: Both lines of a two-line label sit inside one border.

#### Mirror text (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/mirror

1. `Menu` → Format → `OK` → Mirror → `OK`.
2. `◀` / `▶` to On → `OK`.

#### Vertical labels (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/vertical

1. Press `Vertical`.
2. Type the text.
3. Press `Print`.

Note: On a two-line vertical label, line 2 prints to the right of line 1. Underline will not print.

#### Fixed-length labels (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/length

1. `Menu` → Format → `OK` → Label length → `OK`.
2. `◀` / `▶` to Fixed.
3. `▲` / `▼` or the number keys for 40–400 mm (1.5"–15") → `OK`.

Note: Text is scaled to fit. If it cannot fit, you are asked to print a variable-length label instead. Fixed length stays on until you switch back to variable.

#### Align text (fixed-length only) (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/align

1. `Menu` → Format → `OK` → Alignment → `OK`.
2. `◀` / `▶` to Left, Centre or Right → `OK`.

Note: Default is centred. Alignment is ignored on variable-length labels. Those always print centred. This guide has no justify setting.

#### Two-line labels (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/two-lines

1. Type line 1.
2. Press `Return`.
3. Type line 2.
4. Press `Print`.

Note: Maximum two lines. 6 mm (1/4") tape is one line only.

#### Insert a symbol (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/symbol

1. Press `Symbols`, or `Menu` → Insert → “Symbols” → `OK`.
2. Move with the navigation keys to the cell.
3. Press `OK`.

#### Insert clip art (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/clipart

1. `Menu` → Insert → “Clip Art” → `OK`.
2. Move with the navigation keys to the image.
3. Press `OK`.

#### Accented characters (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/accents

1. Press `Accent` then the letter, or press and hold the letter.
2. When the variants appear, `◀` / `▶` to the one you want → `OK`.

Note: Worked example in this guide: hold `a` and you see a à â æ and the rest of that letter’s set.

#### Date and time (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/datetime

1. Format: `Menu` → Settings → Date/Time → Notation → pick a date or date-and-time format → `OK`.
2. Set date: `Menu` → Settings → Date/Time → Set date → day, month, year → `OK`, then `Back` twice.
3. Set time: `Menu` → Settings → Date/Time → Set time → hour and minutes → `OK`, then `Back` twice.
4. Insert: `Menu` → Insert → “Date and Time” → `OK`.

#### Auto-numbering (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/numbering

1. `Menu` → Insert → “Auto-numbering” → `OK`.
2. Pick numeric (0–9), uppercase (A–Z) or lowercase (a–z) → `OK`.
3. Set start and end values → `OK`.

Note: Up to 10 labels in the series. You can put text before and after the number. Only one auto-number per label. Delete it as one character with `Backspace` at the end of the number.

#### Print, preview and copies (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/print

1. Type the label.
2. Preview / copies: hold `Print` a few seconds. The LCD shows length, width and layout; `▲` / `▼` sets 1–10 copies, then `OK`.
3. A short press of `Print` prints. Press the cutter button to cut.
4. Peel: find the split in the backing, pinch the label lengthwise toward the printed side so the backing separates, then peel.

Note: After a copies run the copy count returns to 1.

#### Save, open and insert saved text (9 slots) (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/files

1. Save: press `Save/Open`. The first free slot is shown. Move to a slot (you may overwrite) → `OK`. Text and formatting are stored.
2. Open: hold `Save/Open`, or `Menu` → Open, then pick a slot → `OK`.
3. Insert saved text only: put the cursor where you want it → `Menu` → Insert → “Saved text” → pick a slot → `OK`. Formatting is not inserted.

#### Language, label width and units (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/settings

1. Language: `Menu` → Settings → current language → `OK` → `▲` / `▼` → `OK`.
2. Label width: `Menu` → Settings → current width → `OK` → `◀` / `▶` → `OK`. You can set this even if a different cassette is inserted.
3. Units: `Menu` → Settings → units → English (inches) or Metric (default).

#### Clean the cutter and print head (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/clean

1. Cutter: remove the cassette. Press and hold the cutter button to expose the blade. Wipe both sides with a cotton swab and alcohol.
2. Print head: remove the cassette. Take the cleaning tool from inside the cover (or contact DYMO if it is missing). Wipe the padded side of the tool across the print head.

Note: The cutter blade is extremely sharp. Clean it each time you change tape.

#### Use with a computer (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/howto/usb

1. Install DYMO desktop software from support.dymo.com before plugging in USB (close Office apps on Windows first).
2. Then plug USB into the top of the maker and into the computer.
3. Turn the maker on. If several DYMO printers are installed, pick LabelManager 280 in the software Print area.

### Error messages

#### “No display” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/no-display

Meaning: Maker is off, or the pack is flat.
Fix: Turn it on. Attach the charging adapter and recharge the pack.

#### “Poor print quality” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/poor-print-quality

Meaning: Weak pack, dirty head, or a bad cassette.
Fix: Recharge. Clean the print head. Reseat or replace the D1 cassette.

#### “Auto-numbering already inserted” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/auto-numbering-already-inserted

Meaning: The label already has an auto-number. Only one is allowed.
Fix: Delete the existing auto-number with `Backspace` at the end of it, then insert again if needed.

#### “Battery Failure!” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/battery-failure

Meaning: Pack not seated, or damaged.
Fix: Reseat the pack. Replace it if it still fails.

#### “Wait n minutes / Battery Charging” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/wait-n-minutes-battery-charging

Meaning: Pack is charging and is not ready to unplug.
Fix: Leave the adapter connected until charging finishes.

#### “Too Many Characters!” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/too-many-characters

Meaning: The edit buffer is full.
Fix: Delete text, use a smaller point size, drop a line, or insert a wider cassette.

#### “No label found. / Insert label cartridge.” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/no-label-found-insert-label-cartridge

Meaning: No cassette in the compartment.
Fix: Insert a D1 cassette and set the label width.

#### “Label jam!” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/label-jam

Meaning: Motor stalled on jammed tape.
Fix: Open the cover, remove the cassette, clear the jam, clean the cutter, make sure tape and ribbon are taut across the mouth and through the guides.

#### “Printing...” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/printing

Meaning: Print in progress.
Fix: Wait. The message clears when printing finishes.

#### “Print label with variable length? / Label length exceeds fixed length.” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/print-label-with-variable-length-label-length-exceeds-fixed

Meaning: Text does not fit the fixed length.
Fix: `OK` prints variable length, or shorten the text / reduce size / drop a line / use wider tape.

#### “Too many lines for selected label width” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/too-many-lines-for-selected-label-width

Meaning: Two lines on 6 mm tape, or more lines than the width allows.
Fix: Delete a line, reduce size, use 9 or 12 mm tape, or switch to variable length.

#### “Label Length Exceeds Fixed Length!” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/label-length-exceeds-fixed-length

Meaning: Same fit problem, shown as an error.
Fix: Delete text, or print with variable length.

#### “Charge Battery!” (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/charge-battery

Meaning: Pack is too low to print.
Fix: Attach the adapter, check the pack is seated, or replace the pack.

### Problems and fixes

#### Display stays blank (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/display-stays-blank

Confirm power is on and the pack is charging / charged. The adapter does not run the maker without a pack.

#### Too much blank tape on the label (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/too-much-blank-tape-on-the-label

Use a fixed length (40–400 mm) if you need a specific size. Variable-length labels are sized to the text and are always centred.

#### Nothing prints, or print is faint / broken (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/nothing-prints-or-print-is-faint-broken

Recharge, clean the print head, reseat the cassette with tape under the guides, replace a worn cassette.

#### Tape jammed (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/tape-jammed

Open the cover, pull the cassette, clear jammed tape, rewind slack on the ribbon spool, clean the cutter, reinsert.

#### Cutter does not cut cleanly (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/cutter-does-not-cut-cleanly

Clean both sides of the blade with alcohol (hold the cutter button to expose it).

#### Want a fresh label (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/want-a-fresh-label

Press `New label/Clear` and pick text-only or text-and-format.

#### How do I peel the backing? (DYMO LabelManager 280)
https://labelarium.com/d/dymo-lm280/trouble/how-do-i-peel-the-backing

DYMO labels have a split back. Pinch lengthwise toward the printed side so the split opens, then peel.

### Shortcuts

- `Symbols` (the ,# key): Open the symbol picker without going through Menu
- `Menu` → Insert → “Symbols” → `OK`: Insert a symbol from the 132-cell set
- `Menu` → Insert → “Clip Art” → `OK`: Insert clip art from the 89-cell set
- hold a letter, or `Accent` then a letter: Accented characters (example on a: a à â æ …)
- `B` / `I` / `U`: Toggle bold, italic, underline
- `Vertical`: Toggle vertical text
- `AAA` (text size): Step the point size
- `Caps`: Toggle capitals (default on)
- `Print` hold: Preview layout, or set 1–10 copies
- `Save/Open`: Save to one of 9 memory slots
- hold `Save/Open`: Open a saved label
- `New label/Clear`: Clear text, or text and formatting
- `Back`: Leave a menu without changing anything
- `Return`: Second line on 9 / 12 mm tape
- `Menu` → Format: Font, size, style, borders, length, alignment, mirror
- `Menu` → Insert: Symbols, clip art, date and time, auto-numbering, saved text
- `Menu` → Settings: Language, label width, units (inches / mm)

### Specs

- Tape: DYMO D1 tape cassettes, 6 / 9 / 12 mm (1/4" / 3/8" / 1/2")
- Print: Thermal transfer. Product page lists 15 mm/s. Two lines max (9 & 12 mm tape)
- Text: Graphical LCD. Buffer limit is the “Too Many Characters!” message. The guide does not state a character cap
- Fonts: 3 font types (Basic, Serif, Fun) · 6 point sizes (8–24 pt, tape-width limited) · 7 printed text styles
- Decorations: 8 borders · 132 symbols · 89 clip-art cells. No template library in this guide
- Memory: 9 saved labels (text and formatting). Saved text can be inserted into the current label without its formatting
- Power: Li-ion pack 7.2 V 600 mAh 4.32 Wh. Charge only in the label maker with adapter DSA-6PFG-12 Fc 120050 (12 V / 0.5 A). Full charge ~3 hours; after ~10 minutes of charging you can print. The adapter cannot power the maker. It only charges the pack
- Auto power off: After 2 minutes idle. Last label text and style are remembered when power returns
- Computer: USB on the top edge. Standalone, or print from DYMO desktop software (install software before plugging in USB)
- Item: 1815990 (DYMO product page)

## Brady M210
Portable Industrial Label Printer. 221 symbols in 9 categories, 11 templates, Brady Fixed Width Condensed typeface, 2 styles, 22 shortcuts, 15 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210

### How-to guides

#### Pick a label type (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/label-type

1. Press `Label Type`.
2. Use `▲` / `▼` to the type that matches the job and the cartridge, then `Enter`.
3. Fill data fields if shown, then `Enter`.
4. To leave a special type and return to general editing, pick “Banner Portrait”.

Note: Types that the cartridge cannot use are hidden. SelfLam → Banner Landscape, Fixed Length, Wire. Permasleeve → Banner Landscape, Fixed Length.

#### Font size and Bold (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/font

1. Press `Font Size`.
2. Navigate to Auto, a point size, or the Bold variant, then `Enter`.

Note: One typeface. Size applies to the whole label. Autosize shows “A” and shrinks until `Enter` or the minimum. Default 9 pt. Some symbols need 9 pt or larger.

#### Insert a symbol (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/symbol

1. Press `Symbol` (`Alt` + `1`).
2. Pick the category → `Enter`.
3. Pick the glyph → `Enter`.

Note: Last category is remembered. See the Symbols section for every printed Appendix A cell.

#### Code 39 / Code 128 (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/barcode

1. Use Banner Landscape or Flag.
2. Press `Barcode` (`Alt` + `2`).
3. Pick “39” or “128” → `Enter`.
4. Type the data. `Font Size` scales the bars with the human-readable line (always below, cannot be removed).
5. Move right off the box to stop editing the barcode.

Note: Allowed characters are in Appendix B. No checksum. One serialized set can sit inside a barcode.

#### Datamatrix and QR (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/2d

1. Install 0.75" (19.1 mm) media. Set “Banner Landscape”.
2. Press the 2D key (next to Barcode on the pad).
3. Pick Datamatrix or QR, small or large → `Enter`.
4. Type up to 44 characters (Datamatrix) or 50 (QR). Sizes are fixed. Font size does not change them.

Note: Minimum readable diameter for a Brady scanner is 0.59" (15 mm). Multiple lines of text/codes are not supported.

#### Serialization (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/serial

1. Press `Serial` (`Alt` + `Menu`).
2. Enter Start, Increment (not 0; default 1) and End → `Enter`.
3. Letters A–Z use alphabetic order; increment is still a number. Do not mix letters and digits in one sequence. Up to three letters (AB…BB rolls the left character).

Note: Simple sequences only. One serialized set per file. Edit later with `Serial` from anywhere on the label. `Backspace` on the start value can delete the whole sequence (confirm “Delete Serial?”).

#### Save, open, delete (12 files) (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/files

1. Save: `Menu` → “File” → `Enter` → “Save” → `Enter` → empty slot → `Enter` → name (11 chars) → `Enter`.
2. Overwrite: pick an occupied slot → “Yes” → new name.
3. Open: `Menu` → “File” → “Open” → slot → `Enter` (unsaved screen data is lost).
4. Delete: `Menu` → “File” → “Delete” → slot → “Yes”. `Backspace` leaves the list.

Note: Files survive battery removal. Two files may share a name; slots 1–12 distinguish them. No PC connection.

#### Print, Multi-Print and cut (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/print

1. Press `Print`. A print icon and remaining-supply gauge show until the job finishes.
2. Squeeze the cutter levers. Plastic grips hold the label in the chute. Pull it out.
3. Copies: `Multi-Print` (`Alt` + `Print`) → Copies: → `Enter`. Cut between labels or press `Print` again to keep going.
4. Job-wide cut behaviour: `Menu` → “Cut Mode” → “Cut Between Labels” / “Cut at End of Job”.

#### Clear vs Backspace (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/clear

1. `Backspace` deletes one character to the left and also backs out of menus.
2. `Clear` (`Alt` + `Backspace`) wipes data but keeps font size and label type.

#### Multiple lines (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/lines

1. `Enter` starts a new line (max four).
2. Do not press `Enter` at the end of a line unless you want another line. A blank line still counts.

Note: Pre-sized labels may allow fewer than four. “Cannot Fit” means shrink the font, delete text, or change type/orientation.

#### Units, clock, zero style, backlight (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/units-clock

1. Units: `Menu` → “Units” → inches or mm.
2. Clock: `Menu` → “Set Clock” → Clock Format (12/24), Date Format (MM/DD/YY or DD/MM/YY, 2- or 4-digit year), Time Format, then Date and Time.
3. Zero: `Menu` → “Set Zero Style” → open 0 or slashed zero.
4. Backlight: `Menu` → “Backlight Time” → 5–30 s, Always On (AC), or Always Off. `Alt` + `Space` toggles the lamp.

#### Language (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/language

1. On first power-up go to `Menu` → “Language” (6th item; the word is already in the current language).
2. Pick the language → `Enter`.

Note: If you mash keys during setup and cannot change language, reset language from that same menu (see Troubleshooting).

#### Change the M21 cartridge (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/cartridge

1. Turn the lock left to horizontal (unlock).
2. Press the rear eject button and lift the cartridge out.
3. Drop a Brady Authentic M21 cartridge in until it snaps. Turn the lock right to vertical.
4. Unlock when you finish a run so the warm head does not burn a line onto the next label.

#### Batteries and adapter (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/power

1. Six new AA alkaline in the back compartment (finger tabs). Do not mix used/new, and do not use rechargeable AA or Ultimate Lithium AA.
2. Optional M210-BATTERY: label down, elongated end into the bottom slot. Charge only on the M210-AC adapter outside the printer. To print while charging, put AA cells in the printer.
3. Optional 9 V Brady adapter in the left-side jack powers the printer but does not charge the pack inside.

#### Clean print head, roller and sensor (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/howto/clean

1. Power off. Unlock and remove the cartridge.
2. Blow the sensor with compressed air or a lint-free swab.
3. Swab the print head and platen with isopropyl alcohol (or Brady PCK-6).
4. LCD: soft cloth, light isopropyl.

### Error messages

#### “Error” (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/error

Meaning: Low battery, wrong media, or motor fault.
Fix: Fit six new AA cells, or recharge the Li-ion pack on the adapter (use AA in the printer while it charges). Fit a Brady Authentic cartridge. If it stays up, send the printer for repair.

#### “Cannot Fit” (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/cannot-fit

Meaning: Font, lines or length will not fit. Some symbols cannot print at 6 pt. A blank line counts. Wrong type/orientation (e.g. WireMarker instead of Banner).
Fix: Smaller font, delete text, drop extra `Enter`s, switch to Banner Landscape, or lengthen a fixed/custom label. For symbols use 9 pt or larger.

#### “No / Invalid Cartridge” (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/no-invalid-cartridge

Meaning: Empty bay, non-Authentic cartridge, or damaged smart cell.
Fix: Fit a cartridge with the Authentic A logo. `CLEAR/ESC` to dismiss.

#### “Insert labels” (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/insert-labels

Meaning: Damaged contacts in the receiver slot.
Fix: Contact Brady Technical Support.

#### “Check Cartridge / Lever” (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/check-cartridge-lever

Meaning: Lock not engaged, cartridge empty, or jam.
Fix: Lock vertical. New cartridge. Unlock, pull the cartridge, cut off the damaged leader, reinsert.

#### “Cut while printing” (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/cut-while-printing

Meaning: Cutter used during a job.
Fix: Finish the cut through the material. `Clear` the error. Reprint.

#### “Invalid terminal repeat value” (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/invalid-terminal-repeat-value

Meaning: Spacing out of range.
Fix: Enter 0.2" (5.08 mm) to 40" (1016 mm).

### Problems and fixes

#### Printer does not power up (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/printer-does-not-power-up

Charge or replace the pack, or install six new AA cells. To print while the Li-ion pack charges on the adapter, put AA cells in the printer.

#### Screen freezes (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/screen-freezes

Power off. If Power does nothing, unplug the adapter, pull the pack/cells, reseat, power on.

#### LCD reverts to the previous label (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/lcd-reverts-to-the-previous-label

Battery is low. Replace or recharge.

#### Printer powers off often (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/printer-powers-off-often

Auto-off is 10 minutes idle. Fit fresh AA or the AC adapter. Charge Li-ion outside the printer.

#### Poor print / voids / wrinkles (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/poor-print-voids-wrinkles

Worn cells, dirty head (clean with alcohol), unusable media, crease in the tape (advance past it), or wrinkled ribbon (unlock, turn the take-up spool clockwise 1–2 turns).

#### Black line on the first label of a run (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/black-line-on-the-first-label-of-a-run

Cartridge was left locked, so the warm head sat on the ribbon. Unlock as soon as you finish printing.

#### Will not feed / Print does nothing (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/will-not-feed-print-does-nothing

Cut a straight leader. Confirm the lock is vertical. Clear the exit chute. Try another cartridge.

#### Compressed print / bad registration (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/compressed-print-bad-registration

Remove the last cut label from the tray. Clean the platen.

#### Cutter does not cut (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/cutter-does-not-cut

Tweezers or needle-nose pliers for slivers, never fingers. Sharp cutter parts.

#### Jam, cannot feed (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/jam-cannot-feed

Unlock (force if needed; unlock retracts the platen), remove the cartridge, clear with tweezers. Do not scratch the print head with metal.

#### Keys stuck or dead (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/keys-stuck-or-dead

Find a key jammed down and press it free.

#### Left/right justification does nothing (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/left-right-justification-does-nothing

Not supported. Everything prints centered. No action.

#### Human-readable barcode text cannot move / no checksum (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/human-readable-barcode-text-cannot-move-no-checksum

Fixed below the bars. Checksum is not offered.

#### Menu hides some label types (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/menu-hides-some-label-types

The cartridge decides. Nylon/vinyl/polyester continuous: all types. SelfLam: Banner Landscape, Fixed Length, Wire. Permasleeve: Banner Landscape, Fixed Length. 2D codes: 0.75" only.

#### Datamatrix / QR will not enter (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/datamatrix-qr-will-not-enter

Set Banner Landscape (not Portrait) and 0.75" media.

#### Pre-sized text is shifted (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/pre-sized-text-is-shifted

Debris on the sensor. Remove the cartridge and blow it off.

#### Cannot change language (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/cannot-change-language

Wrong key during setup. `Menu` → “Language” and set it again.

#### Want a PC connection (Brady M210)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m210/trouble/want-a-pc-connection

There is none. The M210 cannot print PC files. Brady sells other printers that can.

### Shortcuts

- `Alt` + `1`: Symbols catalog
- `Alt` + `2`: Barcode (Code 39 or Code 128)
- `Alt` + `6`: International / accented characters
- `Alt` + `Z`: Insert date from the printer clock
- `Alt` + `Y`: Insert time from the printer clock
- `Alt` + `Label Type`: Feed media
- `Alt` + `Menu`: Serialization
- `Alt` + `Print`: Multi-Print copies
- `Alt` + `Space`: Backlight
- `Alt` + `Backspace`: Clear all data (keep format)
- `Alt` + `Font Size`: Caps Lock
- `Font Size`: Size and Bold (Auto, 6, 9, 14, 20, 28, 40 pt)
- `Label Type`: Application templates (banner, vial, wire, flag, …)
- `Print`: Print the current file
- `Enter`: Accept a menu item, or start a new line (max four)
- `Backspace`: Delete left; also cancel menus one screen at a time
- `Menu` → “File”: Save / Open / Delete one of 12 files
- `Menu` → “Units”: Inches or millimetres
- `Menu` → “Language”: Printer language (6th item; the word itself is already localised)
- `Menu` → “Cut Mode”: Cut between labels, or cut at end of job
- `Menu` → “Set Zero Style”: Open zero vs slashed zero
- `Menu` → “Timestamp” → “Insert Date” / “Insert Time”: Stamp date or time without the dedicated keys

### Specs

- Printers: M210 (industrial + lab types) and M210-LAB (laboratory types only). Same hardware; label-type menus differ. A Russian / Cyrillic-keypad M210 also exists.
- Print: 203 dpi thermal transfer. Max print width 0.75" (19.1 mm). Max alphanumeric length 99.9" (253.7 cm). Max 50 characters. Up to 4 lines.
- Symbols: Official counts: M210 194 · M210 with Cyrillic keypad 218 · M210-LAB 131. This pack lists every filled cell printed in Appendix A of the shared M210/M210-LAB manual (221 glyphs).
- Typeface: One typeface: Brady Fixed Width Condensed. Sizes Auto / 6 / 9 / 14 / 20 / 28 / 40 pt, each with a Bold weight. Default 9 pt. No extra fonts, widths or frames.
- Media: Brady Authentic M21 cartridges, continuous 0.25"–0.75" (6.35–19.1 mm) or pre-sized. Smart-cell sets many format details. No PC port. Cannot print from a computer.
- Memory: 12 saved files (name up to 11 characters). Files survive battery removal.
- Barcodes: Code 39 and Code 128 (Banner Landscape or Flag). Datamatrix (max 44 chars) and QR (max 50 chars), small/large; 0.75" media and Banner Landscape only.
- Power: 6 × AA alkaline (not rechargeable AA, not Ultimate Lithium), optional M210-BATTERY Li-ion pack (charges only on the AC adapter, outside the printer), or optional 9 V Brady AC adapter (M210-AC / 110416 / 110417). Auto-off after 10 minutes idle.
- Size / weight: 243.84 × 63.5 × 124.46 mm (9.6" × 2.5" × 4.9"), 0.75 kg / 1.66 lb with battery pack
- Environment: Operating 4–43 °C (40–110 °F), 20–90% RH non-condensing. Direct sunlight not recommended.
- Languages: M210: 20 (English default, French, Spanish, German, Dutch, Portuguese, Italian, Czech, Danish, Estonian, Finnish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Slovakian, Slovenian, Swedish, Turkish, Croatian). M210-LAB: English, French, Spanish, German, Dutch, Portuguese, Italian. M210 Russian: Russian default + English. Greek letters live under International, not Language.

## Brady M211 Label Printer
Bluetooth portable printer · Express Labels app. 22 symbols in 4 categories, 10 shortcuts, 11 how-to guides. Page: https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211

### How-to guides

#### Charge before first use (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/charge

1. Plug USB-C into the printer.
2. Use the supplied AC adapter (at least 15 W) and the regional plug.
3. Charge about 2.5 hours. The battery light pulses green, then stays solid green.

Note: USB-A ports and weaker adapters charge more slowly.
Note: If the pack was run completely flat and left unused about four weeks, reconditioning can take 6–8 hours.

#### Power, Bluetooth reset and hard boot (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/power

1. Tap `Power` to turn on or off. Bluetooth is on whenever the printer is on.
2. Hold `Power` 5 seconds until the Bluetooth light pulses to drop the current phone.
3. Hold `Power` 15 seconds to hard-boot a frozen printer. Battery and Bluetooth lights come on when it has restarted.

#### Connect Express Labels over Bluetooth (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/connect

1. Install Brady Express Labels (Android 6.0+ or iOS 10.0+; phone needs Bluetooth 4.2+).
2. Turn the M211 on.
3. Open the app. It should detect the printer. Rename if you want, then tap connect.

Note: Only one mobile device at a time. If the printer does not appear, hold `Power` 5 seconds to release the previous pairing.
Note: Range is about 65 ft (19.8 m).

#### Shutdown time and printer name (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/settings

1. Shutdown: open an M211 label file → tap the gear → set idle time (default 30 minutes).
2. Name: in the app printer list, open the more menu → rename.

Note: These settings live in the app session, not on the printer. The next user starts from defaults. Language and units are app-wide.

#### Load an M21 cartridge (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/load

1. Turn the lock lever counter-clockwise to unlock (power may be on or off).
2. Press `Eject` on the back and lift the cartridge out.
3. Drop the new Brady Authentic cartridge in until it snaps.
4. Turn the lever clockwise to lock.

Note: Only cartridges with the Brady Authentic mark. Smart-cell tells the app the media and sets many format details.
Note: Unlock the cartridge whenever you are not printing. A locked idle printer can transfer a black line onto the first label from residual heat.

#### Print from the app (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/print

1. Printer on, cartridge locked.
2. Open the label file on the phone.
3. Tap Print. The app sends the job.
4. If the cartridge runs out mid-job, printing stops and the error light comes on. The app shows the message.

Note: There is no on-printer editor. An SDK exists if you need other software; see Brady’s programming site.

#### Auto-cut and the Cut button (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/cut

1. Set cut-between-labels or cut-at-end-of-job in the Express Labels file.
2. Press `Cut` on the printer for a manual cut.

Note: If cuts are rough, fragments may be in the cutter. Unlock, remove the cartridge, pick fragments with tweezers, never fingers. The cutter is sharp.

#### Fit the magnet accessory (M21-MAGNET) (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/magnet

1. Slide the keeper plate off the magnet.
2. Line the magnet up with the screw holes on the back of the printer.
3. Fit the two screws that come with the magnet.

Note: Neodymium magnet. Keep away from pacemakers, defibrillators, insulin pumps, cards, drives, and explosive atmospheres. Do not give children strong magnets. Wear eye protection if magnets may snap together.

#### Clean the printhead, platen and sensor (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/clean

1. Power off. Unlock and remove the cartridge.
2. Moisten a lint-free swab with isopropyl alcohol, or use Brady PCK-6 swabs.
3. Gently swab the printhead, then the platen (you may need to lock the lever to reach the roller).
4. Blow or swab debris off the position sensor if pre-sized labels print offset.

#### Dismantle a used cartridge for recycling (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/recycle

1. Wear safety glasses and gloves. Use a 1/4-inch flathead screwdriver.
2. Pry the smart cell off the bottom (it is glued).
3. Twist the screwdriver in the seam to split the housing.
4. Remove leftover media, shake out parts, unwind the ribbon from its spools.
5. Bin: housings/retaining arm → #7 PC; springs/washers → #40 metals; smart cell → e-waste; plastic washers/spacers → #1 PETE.

#### Clear a label jam (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/howto/jam

1. Unlock the lever (force it if the jam is large; unlocking retracts the platen).
2. Remove the cartridge.
3. Pull the jammed label and fragments with tweezers or needle-nose pliers.

Note: Metal tools can scratch the printhead. Never use your fingers in the cutter.

### Error messages

#### “The cutter is jammed” (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/the-cutter-is-jammed

Meaning: Error light on; Express Labels reports a cutter jam.
Fix: Follow the in-app instructions. Unlock, remove the cartridge, pick fragments with tweezers. See “Labels are jammed in the printer” in the manual (p. 25).

#### “The supply cartridge is not loaded correctly, missing, or not a Brady Authentic cartridge.” (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/the-supply-cartridge-is-not-loaded-correctly-missing-or-not

Meaning: No cartridge, unlocked, damaged, or a non-Authentic cell.
Fix: Load a Brady Authentic M21 cartridge and lock the lever. See “Loading Cartridges” (p. 10).

#### “The supply cartridge is empty.” (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/the-supply-cartridge-is-empty

Meaning: The smart cell reports no media left.
Fix: Replace the cartridge. Recycle the empty one per local rules (p. 12).

#### “Battery power is too low to print.” (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/battery-power-is-too-low-to-print

Meaning: Pack too flat for a job.
Fix: Plug into the ≥15 W adapter. See “Power Adapter” (p. 5).

#### “The printer battery is getting low.” (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/the-printer-battery-is-getting-low

Meaning: Warning before a hard stop.
Fix: Finish the job if you can, then charge.

#### “An error occurred while printing.” (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/an-error-occurred-while-printing

Meaning: Generic print fault.
Fix: See Troubleshooting Scenarios (p. 24): lock, damage, jam, or hard boot (hold `Power` 15 seconds).

### Problems and fixes

#### Cutter does not cut, or cuts are rough (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/cutter-does-not-cut-or-cuts-are-rough

Fragments in the cutter, or the app is not set to cut. Unlock, remove the cartridge, pick fragments with tweezers, never fingers. Check the file’s cut setting.

#### Labels won’t feed (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/labels-wont-feed

Leading edge of the roll is torn or uneven. Cut a straight edge with scissors and reload.

#### Labels are jammed (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/labels-are-jammed

Unlock (force if needed), remove the cartridge, extract the jam with tweezers. Avoid scratching the printhead.

#### Printer does not turn on (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/printer-does-not-turn-on

Charge with the supplied USB cable. If the pack is charged and it still stays off, hold `Power` 15 seconds.

#### Printer turns off by itself (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/printer-turns-off-by-itself

Low battery, or idle shutdown is shorter than you want (default 30 minutes in Express Labels).

#### Print is light, fuzzy, grainy, offset, or has blank lines (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/print-is-light-fuzzy-grainy-offset-or-has-blank-lines

Advance wrinkled ribbon on the take-up spool clockwise, clean the printhead/platen, try another cartridge, or feed past a crease in the app.

#### First label after sitting idle has a black line (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/first-label-after-sitting-idle-has-a-black-line

Cartridge was left locked. Residual heat transferred ink. Reprint, and unlock when you stop printing.

#### Nothing prints (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/nothing-prints

Lock the lever, check the cartridge, clear a jam, or hard-boot (15 seconds).

#### Text is offset on pre-sized labels (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/text-is-offset-on-pre-sized-labels

Debris on the position sensor. Remove the cartridge and blow it off with compressed air.

#### Battery not full after four hours (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/battery-not-full-after-four-hours

A pack that was fully drained and left unused ~four weeks can take 6–8 hours to recondition.

#### Printer not in Express Labels (Brady M211)
https://labelarium.com/d/brady-m211/trouble/printer-not-in-express-labels

Another phone still holds the pairing. Hold `Power` 5 seconds until Bluetooth pulses, then connect.

### Shortcuts

- tap `Power`: Turn the printer on or off
- hold `Power` 5 seconds: Reset Bluetooth so a new phone can pair (light pulses)
- hold `Power` 15 seconds: Hard boot if the printer is unresponsive
- `Cut`: Manual cut (auto-cut is set in the Express Labels file)
- lock lever clockwise: Lock the cartridge (required before print)
- lock lever counter-clockwise: Unlock to load/unload, and whenever the printer sits idle
- `Eject` after unlock: Pop the cartridge out of the bay
- Express Labels → Print: Send the open label file to the M211
- Express Labels → gear: Printer properties including shutdown time (default 30 min)
- Express Labels → printers → more: Rename this M211 (name is not stored on the printer)

### Specs

- Print: Thermal transfer, 203 dpi, up to 0.6 in/s (15.2 mm/s), single colour
- Print area: Width 0.63" (16 mm) max · length 36" (914 mm) max · liner 0.875" (22.2 mm) max
- Labels: M21-series cartridges (ribbon + media in one). Widths 0.235"–0.75" (6.4–19 mm). Min height 0.236" (6 mm)
- Cartridge in the box: M21-750-499 black-on-white nylon cloth, 3/4". Brady Authentic smart-cell only
- Cutter: Automatic cutter with label retention; `Cut` also cuts manually. Cut mode is set in the label file
- Design: Brady Express Labels app (Android 6.0+ or iOS 10.0+, phone Bluetooth 4.2+). No on-printer editor
- Connection: Bluetooth Low Energy 5.0, one phone at a time, about 65 ft (19.8 m)
- Power: Internal 1100 mAh Li-ion (not user-replaceable). USB-C; use the ≥15 W adapter that shipped with the printer
- Charge: About 2.5 h to full (battery LED pulses green, then solid). Deep-discharged packs may need 6–8 h
- Duty: Up to 300 labels per charge; 100 labels/day recommended
- Auto power off: Default 30 minutes idle; set in Express Labels. Settings are not stored on the printer
- Size / weight: 11.0 × 4.5 × 4.6 in (279 × 113 × 116 mm), 1.2 lb (0.54 kg) with cartridge
- Environment: Operate 40–110 °F (4–43 °C), 20–90% RH non-condensing. Drop 6 ft (1.8 m); crush 250 lb (113.4 kg)
- Manual: Y5067197 Revision A-3, © 2025 Brady Worldwide, Inc.
